9life.au.title: New Neighbourhoods
9life.au.description: S1 E2 This week, Walt and Emmylou head to Perth in Western Australia, to explore the big new housing estates growing there and meet some of the local builders helping shape these new communities.

9life.au.title: Dream Homes Revealed
9life.au.description: S5 E17 Elevated Living We discover the benefits of elevated living. These two-storey homes combine style, functionality and impressive spaces from top to bottom.

9life.au.title: Dream Homes Revealed
9life.au.description: S5 E18 All About Curves We tour 4 homes that move beyond straight lines, embracing curves in creative and inspiring ways.

9life.au.title: The Block
9life.au.description: S11 E30 Dining Room and Foyer Week Begins The contestants are now in week 8 of the competition and they turn their attention to their dining rooms and foyers. Some teams have spent too much of their budget in early weeks and others are held back by the severe Melbourne weather playing havoc with the build.

9life.au.title: House Hunters International
9life.au.description: S145 E12 Adulting in Aberdeen, Scotland Recent college graduates search for their first place together on a minimal budget in Aberdeen, Scotland.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S247 E11 Investing in Herself Single mother, having raised her sons, seeks new chapter with first home outside Chicago. Torn between low-maintenance townhome or wiser investment of single-family house on advice of friend.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S250 E12 My Grand Staircase Moment Newlyweds have run out of space in their small house and need a much bigger place in Indianapolis. One is an amateur woodworker who can't wait to dive in a project, but the other can't stand the mess and wants a turnkey, grand Victorian.

9life.au.title: Good Bones
9life.au.description: S5 E4 Old Biker Bar Mina and Karen return to the Old Southside neighborhood to transform an old motorcycle biker bar into a single-family home. The former hangout gets a massive, two-story addition and industrial-modern designs.

9life.au.title: Home Again With The Fords
9life.au.description: S1 E6 Paris in Pittsburgh After living in Philadelphia and New York, Dan and Bridgette move back to their Franklin Park hometown to raise their young boys; the couple hopes that Leanne and Steve can bring this cool '70s home into the modern era.

9life.au.title: Unsellable Houses
9life.au.description: S5 E8 Hygge Bad Pipe Dream Pacific NW real estate. Twin sisters help people sell homes. The sisters put their own money into the renovation. When the home sells, they take their investment off the top of the profits then split the rest with the home owners.

9life.au.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
9life.au.description: S4 E4 Oceanfront Oasis A couple finds an oceanfront property in Jacksonville Beach with potential, but a growing list of problems could prevent their dream home from becoming a reality.

9life.au.title: The Block
9life.au.description: S11 E31 $10,000 Challenge Dwindling budgets are stressing some contestants, and tonight Shelley gives our teams the chance to win $10,000 with an Aldi cooking challenge. It's an opportunity for the teams to use their sparkling new kitchens, and the catch is that they have just $200 to spend.

9life.au.title: Good Bones
9life.au.description: S5 E5 Free House, Expensive Reno Mina and Karen venture into a new neighborhood, Irvington, where Mina acquired a home from a real estate friend. When a serious problem arises with the small cottage, the entire plan for the property changes.

9life.au.title: Masters Of Flip
9life.au.description: S4 E4 Third Time's a Charm Kortney and Dave's latest project turns out to be simple, but Kortney has an axe to grind with the team.

9life.au.title: House Hunters International
9life.au.description: S145 E13 Attempting Adulting in Amsterdam First-time parents get the chance to move to their dream city, Amsterdam; as the realities of parenting in a foreign city set in, they wonder if they've taken on more than they can handle.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S247 E12 A Permanent Home in Atlanta After moving numerous times for work, a couple wants to give their kids a permanent home in the Atlanta area. She's willing to spend top-dollar for a new build, but he thinks getting a deal on a fixer-upper would save them money.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S250 E13 Nail Salons and Relatives in South Carolina A young Chinese immigrant looks to buy a home big enough for her family of eight and her nail salon business in South Carolina. She's searching for a new build that has good feng shui, but finding a place that has everything is a challenge.

9life.au.title: Chateau DIY
9life.au.description: S7 E35 At Christmas Will Nick and Nicole finish their wine cellar in time for Christmas? Janet and Philip re-deck their halls. And there's a Christmas miracle for Bart and Sarah's big extravaganza.

9life.au.title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses
9life.au.description: S1 E3 Britain's Most Expensive Houses Can broker Lee find a buyer for the £17.5 million Huxley House on Billionaire's Row? And Toby's hoping to sell the £1.1 million Black House in York, complete with a car turntable.

9life.au.title: Escape To The Chateau
9life.au.description: S8 E7 Mollusc Madness & Key Moulding Work continues on the chateau's roof and exterior walls, but Dick and Angel uncover more issues. Papi Steve is determined to create a second front door key.

cinemax.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: The Perfect Match
cinemax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: MacGruber
cinemax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Mojave
cinemax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Beirut
cinemax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Arctic
cinemax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Lady Bird
cinemax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Broken City
cinemax.us.description: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Opus
cinemax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

cinemax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

cinemax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

cinemax.us.title: Trap
cinemax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Shazam!
cinemax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
cinemax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Black Adam
cinemax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

cinemax.us.title: Colette
cinemax.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Dilemma
cinemax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Contagion
cinemax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Mickey 17
cinemax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

cinemax.us.title: The Switch
cinemax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: Rampage
cinemaxwest.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemaxwest.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

cinemaxaction.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Rover
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-06-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider

hbocomedy.us.title: Happy Feet Two
hbocomedy.us.description: Mumble (Elijah Wood) the penguin, now called the Master of Tap, has an unusual problem: Erik, his son, is reluctant to dance. Erik runs away from home and encounters the Mighty Sven (Hank Azaria) -- a penguin that can fly. Poor Mumble can't compete with Erik's unusual new role model. But, when the world is shaken by powerful forces, Erik gets a chance to see his father's true colors as Mumble gathers all creatures great and small to set things right again. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Musical, Comedy) - 2011

hbocomedy.us.title: No Hard Feelings

hbocomedy.us.title: Paddington 2
hbocomedy.us.description: Settled in with the Brown family, Paddington the bear is a popular member of the community who spreads joy and marmalade wherever he goes. One fine day, he spots a pop-up book in an antique shop, the perfect present for his beloved aunt's 100th birthday. When a thief steals the prized book, Paddington embarks on a quest to unmask the culprit before Aunt Lucy's big celebration. (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated) - 2017

hbocomedy.us.title: Norm of the North
hbocomedy.us.description: Norm (Rob Schneider) the polar bear doesn't know how to hunt, but he does possess the unique ability to talk to humans. When the wealthy Mr. Greene (Ken Jeong) unveils his idea to build luxury condos in the Arctic, Norm realizes that his beloved home is in jeopardy. Accompanied by three mischievous lemmings, Norm stows away on a ship to New York. Once there, he meets a surprising ally (Michael McElhatton) who helps him hatch a scheme to sabotage the shady developer's plans. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

hbocomedy.us.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
hbocomedy.us.description: The battle for NINJAGO City calls to action young Master Builder Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, also secret ninja warriors. Led by Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, they must defeat the evil warlord Garmadon, who also happens to be Lloyd's dad. Pitting father against son, the epic showdown tests these fierce but undisciplined modern-day ninjas as they learn to check their egos and pull together to unleash the inner power of Spinjitzu. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2017

hbocomedy.us.title: Barbie

hbocomedy.us.title: Dumb Money

In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do in 'Simon Says', then in 'Sing Like A Canary', a cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after he makes too many demands. (S4, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play in 'The Curse of MacBeth', then in 'Zeela The Great', Simon's robot Geizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela. (S5, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore gets stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats in 'The Cat Sitter', then in 'Addicted', The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things. (S3, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead. (S4, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame? (S5, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind. (S5, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure. (S2, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Turf War: Needing to find a part time job to buy the latest video game, Alvin decides to "borrow" Brittany's baby-sitting job. But Basil is not too thrilled at having Alvin look after him! (S1, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Time Capsule: When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Last Day of Summer: Alvin wastes his entire summer playing a video game then tries to do all the fun things he'd planned in one day. (S4, ep 21a)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Gone Gal: When Miss Croner has a disagreement with Miss Miller, she fakes her disappearance to get even. (S5, ep 8a)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's experiments cause trouble when Dave asks him to declutter in 'Pack Animal', then in 'The Haunted Getaway', the boys face a haunted cabin. (S3, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game in 'The Chosen Chipmunk', then in 'Double Dangus', Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully, which will not do. (S4, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave enforces strict study rules after Alvin blames him for bad grades in 'Alvin Gets Schooled', then in 'My Life As a Dog', Theodore acts as a dog. (S5, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipettes set out to prove that being a superhero isn't just a guy thing in 'Super Girls', then in 'Held Back', Alvin must pass his next test, or be separated from his brothers. (S2, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do in 'Simon Says', then in 'Sing Like A Canary', a cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after he makes too many demands. (S4, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon is ecstatic when he's elected the school's safety monitor in "To Serve and Protect", then in "Kickin' It Old School", Dave takes away the Chipmunks technology during a camping trip. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a film in 'Lights Camera Uh-Oh', then in 'Wax Dave', The Chipmunks fear Dave is in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a statue! (S2, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave refuses to let Alvin get a dangerous toy sports car in 'Safety Third', then in 'Mister Manners', Alvin must pass a manners course before he gets his dream meeting with a Princess. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

mgmplus.us.title: Lenny
mgmplus.us.description: Controversial comedian Lenny Bruce (Dustin Hoffman) begins his career telling bad jokes to bored audiences in the 1950s, but can't repress his desire to unleash edgier material. When he does, he begins a one-man campaign to break down social hypocrisy, and his groundbreaking stage act propels him to cult-hero status. When authorities ban Lenny's act for obscenity, he begins a downward spiral of drugs, sex and debt, aided by his bombshell wife, a stripper named Honey (Valerie Perrine). (Biography) - 1974

mgmplus.us.title: September 5
mgmplus.us.description: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2024

mgmplus.us.title: Blue Chips
mgmplus.us.description: Pete Bell (Nick Nolte) is a college basketball coach who has to improve his team's standing -- by any means necessary. His hopes are pinned on a trio of talented players: Neon Boudeaux (Shaquille O'Neal), Butch McRae (Penny Hardaway) and Ricky Roe (Matt Nover). But in order to get them to sign to his school, Bell will have to illegally pay the players off. If he's caught, it could destroy Bell's coaching career and cast a cloud of shame over his team. Will he risk it all to win? (Drama) - 1994

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - Moon News and Markets
mgmplus.us.description: Fred wrestles with selling the false immunity agreement to Tony over the air, taking the story back to 1972. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-18

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 2: Great Britain
mgmplus.us.description: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew; when violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor. (Adventure) - 2026-10-18

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - Back Half
mgmplus.us.description: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar. (Thriller) - 2025-08-03

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - Run
mgmplus.us.description: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust. (Thriller) - 2025-08-10

mgmplus.us.title: Coach Carter
mgmplus.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Drama, Biography) - 2005

mgmplus.us.title: Bulletproof Monk
mgmplus.us.description: For 60 years, a mysterious monk with no name has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scroll keeper. Kar is an unlikely candidate, a streetwise young man whose only interest is himself. But when he inadvertently saves the Bulletproof Monk from capture, the two become partners in a scheme to save the world from the scroll's most avid pursuer. (Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2003

mgmplus.us.title: RoboCop 3
mgmplus.us.description: Greedy corporation Omni Consumer Products is determined to begin development on its dream project, Delta City, which will replace the derelict Detroit. To achieve this end, O.C.P. is employing armed forces to bully residents out of the city, under the guise that they are just doing their part to reduce crime and root out thugs. After RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins the civilian resistance, he sustains severe injuries but recovers to battle advanced ninja robots developed by O.C.P. (Science fiction) - 1993

mgmplus.us.title: The Portable Door
mgmplus.us.description: A man lands an internship at a mysterious London firm with unconventional employees, including the charismatic CEO who is incorporating modern corporate strategy into ancient magical practices. (Fantasy, Adventure) - 2023

mgmplus.us.title: Hondo
mgmplus.us.description: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son. (Western, Drama, Romance, War) - 1953

mgmplus.us.title: Better Man
mgmplus.us.description: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams. (Musical, Biography, Drama) - 2024

mgmplus.us.title: Bloodsport
mgmplus.us.description: U.S. soldier Frank Dux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) has come to Hong Kong to be accepted into the Kumite, a highly secret and extremely violent martial-arts competition. While trying to gain access into the underground world of clandestine fighters, he also has to avoid military officers who consider him to be AWOL. After enduring a difficult training and beginning a romance with journalist Janice Kent (Leah Ayres), Frank is given the opportunity to fight. But can he survive? (Action, Martial arts) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Hercules
mgmplus.us.description: Now a traveling mercenary, Hercules must once again become a hero to help the benevolent king of Thrace protect his people from a powerful warlord. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2014

mgmplus.us.title: She Rides Shotgun
mgmplus.us.description: Marked for death by unrelenting enemies, a newly released ex-con must protect his estranged 11-year-old daughter at all costs. With little resources and no one to trust, they form a bond under fire as they evade a corrupt sheriff and a brutal gang leader who'll stop at nothing to protect his criminal interests. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: RoboCop
mgmplus.us.description: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters. (Science fiction, Action) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: RoboCop 2
mgmplus.us.description: Cyborg Detroit policeman Alex Murphy is the sole officer on duty after the police force goes on strike against evil conglomerate Omni Consumer Products and its push to foreclose on the city of Detroit. Aside from dealing with the normal level of crime, Murphy must take on crime boss Cain, the spread of a dangerous new drug called Nuke and the attempt by psychologist Dr. Juliette Faxx to create another RoboCop using a hardened criminal. (Science fiction, Action) - 1990

mgmplus.us.title: Gladiator II
mgmplus.us.description: Years after witnessing the death of Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius must enter the Colosseum after the powerful emperors of Rome conquer his home. With rage in his heart and the future of the empire at stake, he looks to the past to find the strength and honor needed to return the glory of Rome to its people. (Historical drama, Adventure, Action) - 2024

mgmplus.us.title: The Last Samurai
mgmplus.us.description: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. (Adventure, Drama, War, Action) - 2003

mgmplus.us.title: Wildcat
mgmplus.us.description: An ex-black ops team reunites to pull off a desperate heist and save an eight-year-old girl's life. (Thriller) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 1: The Admiral Benbow
mgmplus.us.description: Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess are pulled into a dangerous world when a sailor washes ashore with a pirate's treasure map; deciding to seek the treasure for themselves, they set sail on the Hispaniola, unaware of the danger on board. (Adventure) - 2026-10-11

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 2: Great Britain
mgmplus.us.description: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew; when violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor. (Adventure) - 2026-10-18

mgmplus.us.title: Unprotected Sets - Parish Sashay
mgmplus.us.description: Comic Paris Sashay grows up in a large family in the Washington, D.C., area; Paris takes on racism, feminism and family slay the crowd at her home club, the DC Improv. (Reality, Standup, Comedy) - 2018-11-30

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - WIBC Mystery Science Theater
mgmplus.us.description: Fred is pushed to the brink as he waits to see whether Tony will accept the DA's immunity offer; a moment of connection between him and FBI Special Agent McNally shifts into a tense game of cat and mouse, and Fred must face a moral reckoning. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-11

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - Moon News and Markets
mgmplus.us.description: Fred wrestles with selling the false immunity agreement to Tony over the air, taking the story back to 1972. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-18

mgmplus.us.title: Lady Jane
mgmplus.us.description: King Henry VIII has died, and his only heir, a young Edward VI (Warren Saire), is dying too. Minister John Dudley (John Wood) doesn't want the Roman Catholic Princess Mary (Jane Lapotaire) to become queen, as that would end the Protestant Reformation. Dudley plots to keep Edward alive long enough to name Lady Jane Grey (Helena Bonham Carter) as his heir and also marries Jane to his son, Guilford (Cary Elwes). Jane and Guilford soon fall in love, but the kingdom doesn't believe they should rule. (Historical drama) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: Imagine That
mgmplus.us.description: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

mgmplus.us.title: Baywatch
mgmplus.us.description: When a dangerous crime wave hits the beach, the legendary Mitch Buchannon leads his elite squad of lifeguards on a mission to prove that you don't have to wear a badge to save the bay. Joined by a trio of hotshot recruits, including former Olympian Matt Brody, they ditch the surf and go deep undercover to take down a ruthless businesswoman whose devious plans threaten the future of the bay. (Comedy, Action) - 2017

mgmplus.us.title: North Dallas Forty
mgmplus.us.description: A brutal satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family is bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches. The National Football League refused to help in the production of this movie, suggesting it may have been too near the truth for comfort. From the novel by former NFL player Peter Gent. (Comedy drama) - 1979

mgmplus.us.title: A Fish Called Wanda
mgmplus.us.description: British gangster George Thomason (Tom Georgeson) and his hapless aide, Ken Pile (Michael Palin), draft a pair of arrogant Americans, grifter Wanda Gerschwitz (Jamie Lee Curtis) and weapons expert Otto West (Kevin Kline), for a massive diamond heist. When the job goes badly, Wanda attempts to seduce George's stuffy lawyer, Archie Leach (John Cleese), to find out where George hid the diamonds. Meanwhile, Ken repeatedly attempts to kill an elderly woman (Patricia Hayes) who witnessed the robbery. (Comedy) - 1988

mgmplushits.us.title: Double Impact
mgmplushits.us.description: Nearly 25 years after seeing his father killed by Hong Kong crime boss Raymond Zhang (Philip Chan Yan Kin), Chad Wagner (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is living in Los Angeles as a flourishing yet peaceful martial arts trainer. But Chad has a twin brother, Alex (also Van Damme), who suddenly reunites with his less-aggressive sibling and wants to avenge their father's death. As the pair plan their payback against Zhang, they also struggle to overcome their personal differences. (Action, Drama) - 1991

mgmplushits.us.title: King Kong
mgmplushits.us.description: When a research ship is sent to explore an island thought to be rich in oil, paleontologist Jack Prescott sneaks aboard, having heard strange rumors about the island. En route, the crew rescues Dwan, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. When they arrive, they find native people living in fear of a monster called Kong. The natives kidnap Dwan and sacrifice her to what turns out to be an enormous ape. Dwan is eventually rescued, and the ape captured for a gala exhibit. (Adventure, Fantasy) - 1976

mgmplushits.us.title: Worldbreaker
mgmplushits.us.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead. (Action, Science fiction, Drama) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: Afterburn
mgmplushits.us.description: After a massive solar flare destroys the Eastern Hemisphere, a treasure hunter for hire ventures to Europe to retrieve the coveted Mona Lisa, only to learn that the world needs a hero more than it needs a painting. (Action, Adventure) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: RoboCop
mgmplushits.us.description: In 2028, OmniCorp is at the center of robot technology. While its drones have long been used by the military overseas, their use is forbidden in American law enforcement. However, OmniCorp gets a golden opportunity to crack that market when Detroit cop Alex Murphy is critically injured in the line of duty. By transforming Murphy into a cyborg, OmniCorp executives hope to rake in billions for their shareholders, but they forget one thing: There's still a man inside the machine. (Science fiction, Action) - 2014

mgmplushits.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 2: Great Britain
mgmplushits.us.description: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew; when violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor. (Adventure) - 2026-10-18

mgmplushits.us.title: American Hostage - Moon News and Markets
mgmplushits.us.description: Fred wrestles with selling the false immunity agreement to Tony over the air, taking the story back to 1972. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-18

mgmplushits.us.title: Indiscreet
mgmplushits.us.description: Famous theater actress Anna Kalman (Ingrid Bergman) has resigned herself to her single life, believing that she has missed her chance at meeting a husband. Weary of socializing in Europe, she returns to her London flat, where her sister Margaret (Phyllis Calvert) and diplomat brother-in-law Alfred (Cecil Parker) invite her to a banquet. She demurs until Alfred's banker friend, Philip Adams (Cary Grant), arrives and a flirtation begins. Their romance blossoms -- but he's already married. (Romantic comedy) - 1958

mgmplushits.us.title: Last Train From Gun Hill
mgmplushits.us.description: As the wealthiest and most powerful man in the Wild West town of Gun Hill, cattle rancher Craig Belden (Anthony Quinn) has come to believe he's above the law. When his son, Rick (Earl Holliman), rapes and murders a Native American woman (Ziva Rodann) married to U.S. marshal Matt Morgan (Kirk Douglas), Belden arrogantly declines to allow his son's arrest. The marshal, once a friend of Belden's, takes on the rancher's henchmen and Rick's accomplice (Brian Hutton) to bring the killer to justice. (Western, Romance) - 1959

mgmplushits.us.title: The Fortune Cookie
mgmplushits.us.description: While taping a football game, cameraman Harry Hinkle (Jack Lemmon) ends up slightly injured after a collision with star player "Boom Boom" Jackson (Ron Rich). When Hinkle's scheming brother-in-law, lawyer Willie Gingrich (Walter Matthau), catches wind of the incident, he wants Hinkle to feign paralysis to scam the insurance company. Hinkle agrees to the plan, if only to win back his ex (Judi West). But Hinkle's growing friendship with a guilt-ridden Jackson has him questioning the ploy. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1966

mgmplushits.us.title: Life Is Beautiful
mgmplushits.us.description: A gentle Jewish-Italian waiter, Guido Orefice (Roberto Benigni), meets Dora (Nicoletta Braschi), a pretty schoolteacher, and wins her over with his charm and humor. Eventually they marry and have a son, Giosue (Giorgio Cantarini). Their happiness is abruptly halted, however, when Guido and Giosue are separated from Dora and taken to a concentration camp. Determined to shelter his son from the horrors of his surroundings, Guido convinces Giosue that their time in the camp is merely a game. (Comedy drama, War) - 1997

mgmplushits.us.title: Return to Me
mgmplushits.us.description: Heartbroken and struggling emotionally after his wife's death in a car accident, Bob Rueland (David Duchovny) agrees to go on a blind date set up by his friend Charlie (David Alan Grier). Though the date fizzles, sparks fly between Bob and the waitress, Grace (Minnie Driver), a recovered heart transplant patient with intimacy problems of her own. When Bob discovers Grace's heart came from his own organ donor wife, an unusual romance blossoms between the two. (Romance) - 2000

mgmplushits.us.title: Silence
mgmplushits.us.description: Two 17th-century Portuguese missionaries, Father Sebastian Rodrigues (Andrew Garfield) and Father Francisco Garupe (Adam Driver), embark on a perilous journey to Japan to find their missing mentor (Liam Neeson). While there, the two men minister to the Christian villagers who worship in secret. If caught by feudal lords or ruling samurai, they must renounce their faith or face a prolonged and agonizing death. (Historical drama, Drama) - 2016

mgmplushits.us.title: Zodiac
mgmplushits.us.description: In the late 1960s and 1970s, fear grips the city of San Francisco as a serial killer called Zodiac stalks its residents. Investigators (Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards) and reporters (Jake Gyllenhaal, Robert Downey Jr.) become obsessed with learning the killer's identity and bringing him to justice. Meanwhile, Zodiac claims victim after victim and taunts the authorities with cryptic messages, cyphers and menacing phone calls. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

mgmplushits.us.title: Wonder
mgmplushits.us.description: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out. (Drama) - 2017

mgmplushits.us.description: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew; when violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor. (Adventure) - 2026-10-18

mgmplushits.us.description: Fred wrestles with selling the false immunity agreement to Tony over the air, taking the story back to 1972. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-18

mgmplushits.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
mgmplushits.us.description: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life. (Drama) - 1982

mgmplushits.us.title: Love Story
mgmplushits.us.description: When wealthy Harvard University law student Oliver Barrett IV meets Jenny Cavilleri, a middle-class girl who is studying music at Radcliffe College, it's love at first sight. Despite the protests of Oliver's father, the young couple marry. Oliver finds a job at a legal firm in New York City, but their happy life comes crashing down when it's discovered that Jenny has a terminal illness. Together, they try to cope with the situation as best they can. (Romance, Drama) - 1970

mgmplushits.us.title: Unprotected Sets - Daniel Webb
mgmplushits.us.description: Comic Daniel Webb gives his unique take on being an empowered gay man in the heart of Texas. (Reality, Standup, Comedy) - 2018-10-19

mgmplushits.us.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
mgmplushits.us.description: Naval Reservist pilot Lt. Harry Brubaker (William Holden) is stationed on an aircraft carrier in the Sea of Japan during the Korean War. Although suffering from battle fatigue and longing to return to civilian life with his wife, Nancy (Grace Kelly), he agrees to fly a dangerous bombing mission over North Korea, with the support of his faithful rescue crew, Forney (Mickey Rooney) and Gamidge (Earl Holliman), and his sympathetic commanding officer, Commander Lee (Charles McGraw). (War) - 1954

mgmplushits.us.title: The Wonderful Country
mgmplushits.us.description: Gunman Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) is an American exiled in Mexico for the revenge killing of his father's assassin. Brady, a henchman of the ruthless Castro crime family, travels across the border to Texas to negotiate the sale of black market rifles. When a broken leg delays Brady's return to Mexico, U.S. Army Maj. Colton (Gary Merrill) and Texas Ranger Capt. Rucker (Albert Dekker) attempt to enlist Brady as a sharpshooter in their war against the Apaches. (Western) - 1959

mgmplushits.us.title: Sex Life - Great Sex Is...
mgmplushits.us.description: Exploring one's wild side with animal role play; reconnecting with a troubled couple; clowning around with a surprising dominatrix. (Adults only, Erotic, Documentary) - 2019-08-02

mgmplushits.us.title: Vera Cruz
mgmplushits.us.description: Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximilian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies. (Western, Adventure, Drama) - 1954

mgmplushits.us.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
mgmplushits.us.description: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner. (Drama) - 1961

mgmplushits.us.title: The Italian Job
mgmplushits.us.description: A British crook (Michael Caine) robs gold ingots in Italy by having a computer expert (Benny Hill) cause a traffic jam. (Action, Comedy) - 1969

mgmplushits.us.title: Alfie
mgmplushits.us.description: British-born ladies' man Alfie (Jude Law) exploits his job as a New York City limousine driver to meet and sleep with attractive women -- which infuriates his pseudo-girlfriend Julie (Marisa Tomei), a single mom. His libertine lifestyle is interrupted, however, when his girl-crazy ways end up hurting his best friend, Marlon (Omar Epps). Desperate, Alfie attempts a go at monogamy with the ravishing Nikki (Sienna Miller), but even her good looks aren't enough to keep him out of trouble for long. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2004

mgmplushits.us.title: Ghost Town

movieplex.us.title: Words and Pictures
movieplex.us.description: An art teacher and English teacher have a competition and allow students to vote on the importance of words and pictures. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2013

movieplex.us.title: Bandslam
movieplex.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own. (Musical comedy, Romantic comedy) - 2009

movieplex.us.title: The Treasure
movieplex.us.description: An old sea captain helps three young friends solve the 30-year-old case of a missing lighthouse keeper. (Mystery) - 1990

movieplex.us.title: Marco Polo: Return to Xanadu
movieplex.us.description: Young Marco Polo embarks on an adventure through space and time to save a beautiful princess in the kingdom of Xanadu. (Animated, Fantasy) - 2001

movieplex.us.title: The Ladybug
movieplex.us.description: A seven-spotted ladybug dreams of escaping its glass cage and finding the Golden Canyon, a legendary insect utopia. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2018

movieplex.us.title: Arlo: The Burping Pig
movieplex.us.description: A lonely 7-year-old girl befriends Arlo, a teacup pig who ran away from the circus. She tries to keep Arlo a secret, but his loud belches make it hard for her to hide him from her family. (Comedy) - 2016

movieplex.us.title: Yellowbird
movieplex.us.description: Yellowbird (Seth Green), a tiny orphaned bird that has never left the nest, suddenly finds himself leading a flock on its migration to Africa. (Animated, Adventure) - 2014

movieplex.us.title: Mulan: Princess Warrior
movieplex.us.description: Disguised as a man, Mulan takes her father's place in the army and becomes a skilled soldier. When she discovers a conspiracy against her country, she sets out to save her people and fight for her family's honor. (Animated, Adventure) - 2020

movieplex.us.title: Let Us In
movieplex.us.description: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town. (Science fiction) - 2020

movieplex.us.title: Wickensburg
movieplex.us.description: When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret. (Adventure) - 2023

movieplex.us.title: Return to Wickensburg
movieplex.us.description: Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. A race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands. (Adventure) - 2024

movies.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do the Universe
movies.us.description: Blasting off on a NASA space mission in 1998, mischievous best pals Beavis and Butt-head time travel to the year 2022. As the NSA and U.S. government try to track them down, the clueless teens do their best to adjust to modern life. (Animated, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure) - 2022

movies.us.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
movies.us.description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy) - 1999

movies.us.title: Tropic Thunder
movies.us.description: Tugg Speedman (Ben Stiller), pampered action superstar, sets out for Southeast Asia to take part in the biggest, most-expensive war movie produced, but soon after filming begins, he and his co-stars, Oscar-winner Kirk Lazarus (Robert Downey Jr.), comic Jeff Portnoy (Jack Black) and the rest of the crew, must become real soldiers when fighting breaks out in that part of the jungle. (Comedy, Action, Adventure, War, Drama) - 2008

movies.us.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
movies.us.description: Hotshot television anchorman Ron Burgundy welcomes upstart reporter Veronica Corningstone into the male-dominated world of 1970s broadcast news -- that is, until the talented female journalist begins to outshine Burgundy on air. Soon he grows jealous, begins a bitter feud with Veronica and eventually makes a vulgar slip on live TV that ruins his career. However, when an outrageous story breaks at the San Diego Zoo, Ron may get a chance to redeem himself. (Comedy) - 2004

movies.us.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
movies.us.description: Seven years after capturing the heart of co-anchor Veronica Corningstone (Christina Applegate), newsman Ron Burgundy (Will Ferrell) is offered the chance of a lifetime: a spot on the world's first 24-hour global cable news network. Ron quickly assembles his team: Champ Kind (David Koechner), Brian Fantana (Paul Rudd) and Brick Tamland (Steve Carell). Challenged by his tough female boss, a network owner and a popular anchor, Ron and his pals must find their own way to the top of the ratings. (Comedy) - 2013

movies.us.title: Blades of Glory
movies.us.description: Figure skaters Chazz Michael Michaels and Jimmy MacElroy take their intense rivalry too far during the Olympic Winter Games in Salt Lake City; both are banned from competition after a nasty brawl. After several years out of the public eye and hungry for glory, the men decide to set aside their feud and exploit a loophole that allows them to compete as a pair. (Comedy) - 2007

movies.us.title: Daddy's Home
movies.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

movies.us.title: Daddy's Home

(Comedy) - 2015

movies.us.title: Zoolander
movies.us.description: Propelled to the top of the fashion world by a photogenic gaze he calls Blue Steel, dimwitted male model Derek Zoolander (Ben Stiller) thinks he's got a fourth consecutive win as Male Model of the Year in the bag. But, when his rival, Hansel (Owen Wilson), unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu (Will Ferrell), who signs Derek to star in his Derelicte fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister. (Comedy, Action) - 2001

movies.us.title: Zoolander 2
movies.us.description: Former models Derek Zoolander (Ben Stiller) and Hansel find themselves thrust back into the spotlight after living in seclusion for years. Invited to a major fashion event in Rome, the estranged friends are surprised to see how much the business has changed. Even more shocking is their encounter with Valentina Valencia, a special agent who needs their help. Someone is killing famous pop stars, and it's up to Derek and Hansel to help save the world's most beautiful people from a similar fate. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

movies.us.title: Airplane!
movies.us.description: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. (Dark comedy) - 1980

movies.us.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
movies.us.description: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

movies.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
movies.us.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

movies.us.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
movies.us.description: Lt. Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) returns for more madcap high jinks in this police-procedural spoof. Powerful energy corporations are intent on putting a halt to the eco-friendly plans of Dr. Albert S. Meinheimer (Richard Griffiths), the new U.S. energy czar. They scheme to replace Meinheimer with an imposter who will do their bidding. Unfortunately for them, Drebin gets tangled up with their plans while trying to steal back his ex (Priscilla Presley) from her slimy new beau (Robert Goulet). (Comedy) - 1991

movies.us.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
movies.us.description: Police Squad Lt. Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) is retired and spending time with his new wife, Jane (Priscilla Presley), when he's called back into action by Capt. Ed Hocken (George Kennedy). A terrorist named Rocco (Fred Ward) plans to bomb the Academy Awards ceremony, so Frank goes undercover as Phil Donahue to try and head off disaster. He causes almost as much trouble as he prevents in an Oscar show complete with over-the-top production numbers and numerous celebrity appearances. (Comedy) - 1994

movies.us.title: The Naked Gun
movies.us.description: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down. (Comedy, Action) - 2025

movies.us.title: She's Out of My League
movies.us.description: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

movies.us.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
movies.us.description: Ferris Bueller (Matthew Broderick) has an uncanny skill at cutting classes and getting away with it. Intending to make one last duck-out before graduation, Ferris calls in sick, "borrows" a Ferrari, and embarks on a one-day journey through the streets of Chicago. On Ferris' trail is high school principal Rooney (Jeffrey Jones), determined to catch him in the act. (Comedy) - 1986

movies.us.title: Election
movies.us.description: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

movies.us.title: Clueless
movies.us.description: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

movies.us.title: Mean Girls
movies.us.description: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. (Comedy) - 2004

movies.us.title: Galaxy Quest
movies.us.description: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1999

movies.us.title: The Addams Family
movies.us.description: When a man (Christopher Lloyd) claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams (Raul Julia), arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. However, Morticia (Anjelica Huston) begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. Gomez realizes the two men are conspiring to swindle the Addams fortune and that he must challenge Fester. (Fantasy, Dark comedy) - 1991

movies.us.title: Addams Family Values
movies.us.description: The members of the odd Addams Family are up to more macabre antics in this sequel. This time around, Gomez Addams (Raul Julia) and his wife, Morticia (Anjelica Huston), are celebrating the arrival of a baby boy. But siblings Wednesday (Christina Ricci) and Pugsley (Jimmy Workman) are none too happy about the new addition, and try their best to eliminate the infant. When nanny Debbie Jellinsky (Joan Cusack) appears to keep the kids in line, her presence leads to an unexpected treacherous twist. (Dark comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

movies.us.title: The Last Airbender
movies.us.description: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. (Fantasy, Adventure) - 2010

movies.us.title: Good Burger
movies.us.description: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street. (Comedy) - 1997

movies.us.title: Good Burger 2
movies.us.description: Dexter Reed and cashier Ed reunite at fast-food restaurant Good Burger with a hilarious new group of employees. (Comedy) - 2023

movies.us.title: The Rugrats Movie
movies.us.description: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1998

movies.us.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
movies.us.description: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2000

movies.us.title: Rugrats Go Wild
movies.us.description: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2003

movies.us.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
movies.us.description: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2002

movies.us.title: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie
movies.us.description: Arnold and his friends find nonstop adventure when they travel to San Lorenzo, Argentina, to find his missing parents. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

movies.us.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
movies.us.description: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2002

screenpixaction.us.title: The Silver Strand
screenpixaction.us.description: A Navy wife (Nicollette Sheridan) is caught between her SEAL-commander husband and her lover, a brash recruit (Gil Bellows). (Drama) - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpixaction.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Topkapi
screenpixaction.us.description: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Matchless
screenpixaction.us.description: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible. (Comedy) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Cul-de-Sac
screenpixaction.us.description: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues. (Comedy) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Ghost of Dragstrip Hollow
screenpixaction.us.description: Lois Cavendish (Jody Fair) hangs out at a nearby soda shop with her drag racing club. But when she learns the shop might be closed, she calls her wealthy aunt, Anastasia (Dorothy Neumann), for help. Anastasia offers the club the chance to use her mansion as their headquarters -- but with one strange condition: They have to scare away the ghost that haunts her home. When the club decides to throw an all-night monster mash party at the mansion, it becomes clear that something is amiss. (Horror) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: The Shadow Returns
screenpixaction.us.description: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) cracks a case of missing jewels, murder and plastics. (Mystery) - 1946

screenpixaction.us.title: The Lost Empire
screenpixaction.us.description: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do, also known as Li Chuk. (Science fiction) - 1984

screenpixaction.us.title: Unholy Rollers
screenpixaction.us.description: A roller-derby newcomer (Claudia Jennings) soon makes enemies for refusing to play by the unwritten rules. (Action, LGBTQ) - 1972
