His brother, Stephen, convinces him to work on one final hustle, targeting an eccentric East Coast heiress named Penelope. The con game fails to play out as planned when Bloom falls in love with the irresistible woman. (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance, Action, Crime drama) - 2008

starzedge.us.title: Tip Toe - Episode 3
starzedge.us.description: When Clive meets Diane, a chance of romance makes him confess long-held secrets; a shock discovery makes his war with Leo escalate, and both households hurtle toward danger. (Thriller, Drama) - 2026-06-07

starzedge.us.title: The Disappearance of Alice Creed
starzedge.us.description: Alice Creed (Gemma Arterton), the daughter of a wealthy family, is kidnapped for ransom by two masked men, one of whom is her boyfriend, Danny (Martin Compston). The other man is Vic (Eddie Marsan), who Danny intends to double-cross once they get the ransom. Although Alice eventually discovers that Danny is one of her abductors, they are forced to continue acting like strangers, since Vic does not know about Alice and Danny's relationship -- and would kill them both if he were to find out. (Thriller) - 2009

starzedge.us.title: The Raven
starzedge.us.description: In 19th-century Baltimore, Detective Emmett Fields (Luke Evans) makes a horrifying discovery: The murders of a mother and daughter resemble a fictional crime described in a story by Edgar Allan Poe (John Cusack). When another murder occurs, also seemingly inspired by Poe's writings, Fields realizes a serial killer is on the loose and enlists Poe's help in catching the felon. The stakes become personal for the struggling author when someone close to him may become the killer's next victim. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2012

starzedge.us.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
starzedge.us.description: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation. (Action, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2008

starzencoreblack.us.title: Let's Be Cops
starzencoreblack.us.description: Best pals Ryan (Jake Johnson) and Justin (Damon Wayans Jr.) are stalled in their respective careers -- a fact that is painfully driven home when they go to a college reunion. Dressed as police in the mistaken belief that they were to attend a costume party, Ryan and Justin find that the uniforms earn them much respect and attention. Although Justin is uncomfortable with the idea, Ryan decides to continue with the charade, putting them both in increasingly dangerous situations. (Comedy, Action) - 2014

starzencoreblack.us.title: A Happening of Monumental Proportions
starzencoreblack.us.description: Administrators at an elementary school scramble to hide a dead body from students and parents on Career Day. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2017

starzencoreblack.us.title: Underworld: Awakening
starzencoreblack.us.description: In the years since she and her human-lycan lover, Michael, defeated Elder Marcus, vampire warrior Selene has been taken captive by humans, while they wage an all-out war against both lycans and vampires. Awakening after more than a decade, Selene discovers that Michael is dead, but that she has given birth to his daughter, Eve. Shunned by nearly all surviving vampires, save one, even Selene seems powerless against her latest opponent: a genetically enhanced lycan. (Fantasy, Action, Horror) - 2012

starzencoreblack.us.title: Fresh
starzencoreblack.us.description: Fresh (Sean Nelson) is a 12-year-old drug dealer who finds himself trapped in a web of poverty, corruption and racial tension in Brooklyn, New York. When his drug-addict sister Nichole (N'Bushe Wright) starts sleeping with local drug lord Esteban (Giancarlo Esposito), Fresh calls upon the skills he learned playing chess with his alcoholic father and speed-chess champion Sam (Samuel L. Jackson) and devises a complex strategy that will free both himself and his sister. (Drama) - 1994

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzencoreblack.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them. (Comedy) - 2005

starzencoreblack.us.title: Out of Sync
starzencoreblack.us.description: A Los Angeles DJ (LL Cool J) in debt to bookies falls for the girlfriend of a drug dealer he is watching for the police. (Crime drama) - 1995

starzencoreblack.us.title: Tales From the Hood 2
starzencoreblack.us.description: A series of bloodcurdling tales about lust, greed, pride and politics. (Horror) - 2018

starzencoreblack.us.title: Tales From the Hood 3
starzencoreblack.us.description: William, a lumbering man in his 50s, tries to outrun an unseen evil with 6-year-old girl Brooklyn, who tells him four different moralistic and horrific stories to keep her mind off the impending danger. (Horror) - 2020

starzencoreblack.us.title: Bones
starzencoreblack.us.description: Jimmy Bones (Snoop "Doggy" Dogg) is a legendary protector and patron of his thriving neighborhood. Cool, handsome and respected - Bones is the benevolent caretaker of his people until he is betrayed by those closest to him. Flash forward 20 years. Crime and drugs have crumbled the neighborhood and Jimmy Bones has become a charismatic emblem of better times. But his spirit is about to make a comeback. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

starzencoreblack.us.title: Tales From the Hood
starzencoreblack.us.description: A creepy mortician, Mr. Simms (Clarence Williams III), attempts to scare teenage drug dealer Stack (Joe Torry) and his friends straight by telling them four horrifying stories. One is about a guilt-riddled cop (Anthony Griffith) who goes crazy after ignoring his corrupt partner (Michael Massee). He also tells of a meek schoolboy (Brandon Hammond) with terrifying supernatural powers. Although the young thugs want to take their drugs and escape Mr. Simms, he still has two more tales to tell. (Horror) - 1995

starzencoreblack.us.title: Liberty Stands Still
starzencoreblack.us.description: As the heir and current marketing director for one of the nation's biggest gun manufacturers, Liberty Wallace (Linda Fiorentino) is indifferent to the atrocities made possible through her business and her CEO husband, Victor (Oliver Platt). On her way to see her actor lover, Liberty ends up chained to a food cart full of explosives -- all at the insistence of Joe (Wesley Snipes), a sniper whose young daughter was a victim of gun violence, and who now has Liberty in his sights. (Thriller, Drama) - 2002

starzencoreblack.us.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Bordello of Blood
starzencoreblack.us.description: After her troublemaking brother, Caleb (Corey Feldman), goes missing, Katherine Verdoux (Erika Eleniak) seeks the services of sarcastic private investigator Rafe Guttman (Dennis Miller) to track the errant youth down. Rafe eventually determines that Caleb is in the thrall of Lilith (Angie Everhart), a powerful vampire who operates a seedy brothel. When Rafe and Katherine set out to rescue Caleb, they must contend with the lethal Lilith and her evil minions. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1996

starzencoreblack.us.description: You are invited to a tasty Thanksgiving dinner that will all at once transport you to four different worlds and take you home again. On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal. (Drama) - 2000

starzencoreblack.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzencoreblack.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story. (Action, Comedy drama) - 2013

starzencoreblack.us.title: Why Men Are Clueless
starzencoreblack.us.description: Omar Baker is a writer who is struggling in both his professional life and his relationship. Omar and his three friends tries to figure out what makes women tick. (Romantic comedy) - 2023

starzencoreblack.us.title: Any Given Sunday
starzencoreblack.us.description: Four years ago, D'Amato's Miami Sharks were at the top. Now, his team is struggling with three consecutive losses, sliding attendance, and aging heroes, particularly 39-year-old quarterback Jack "Cap" Rooney. Off the field, D'Amato is struggling with a failed marriage and estranged children, and is on a collision course with Christina Pagniacci, the young president/co-owner of the Sharks organization. (Drama) - 1999

starzencoreblack.us.description: FBI agent Jake Harris (Val Kilmer) escorts a group of cadets to a remote island for simulation training. The cadets, under the leadership of J.D. (Christian Slater), will try to catch an imaginary serial killer within the island's elaborate facility. The FBI, however, is suspicious of Harris' methods and dispatch Gabe Jensen (LL Cool J) to act as an outside observer. What he finds is a simulation exercise that becomes dangerously real and training that becomes a fight for survival. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2004

starzencoreblack.us.title: Body Count
starzencoreblack.us.description: An art thief (Ice-T) who killed a family learns the son (Justin Theroux) and his girlfriend (Alyssa Milano) are still in the house. (Thriller) - 1997

starzencore.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
starzencore.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

starzencore.us.title: Paranormal Activity 4
starzencore.us.description: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

starzencore.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
starzencore.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

starzencore.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
starzencore.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

starzencore.us.title: Priest
starzencore.us.description: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills. (Fantasy, Horror, Action) - 2011

starzencore.us.title: Death Race 2
starzencore.us.description: Convicted of killing a cop, an inmate (Luke Goss) competes in a brutal race where cars are deadly weapons. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2010

starzencore.us.title: Death Race 3: Inferno
starzencore.us.description: Only one victory away from winning his freedom, legendary driver Carl Lucas (Luke Goss) enters the first Death Race to take place in the brutal Kalahari Desert. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2012

starzencore.us.title: Brick Mansions
starzencore.us.description: In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice. Meanwhile, Damien and an ex-con named Lino (David Belle) work together to save the city from a plot to destroy it. (Action, Crime drama) - 2014

starzencore.us.title: Sahara
starzencore.us.description: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. (Adventure, Action) - 2005

starzencore.us.title: A Lot Like Love
starzencore.us.description: When Oliver and Emily meet on an airplane, they feel an instant connection, but agree that they're wrong for each other. As the years pass and they live their separate lives, fate brings them together several times, and they become close friends. Any time one of them wants more out of the relationship, the other seems content with just being friends. If they wait too long, Oliver and Emily may miss any chance of spending their lives together. (Romantic comedy) - 2005

starzencore.us.title: Morning Glory
starzencore.us.description: Newly hired as a producer on a national morning-news program called "Daybreak," Becky Fuller (Rachel McAdams) decides to revitalize the low-rated show by bringing in legendary anchorman Mike Pomeroy (Harrison Ford). Pomeroy, however, refuses to do puff pieces like celebrity gossip and fashion, and clashes with his co-host (Diane Keaton). Meanwhile, Becky's romance with a colleague begins to unravel, leaving her struggling to save her relationship, her job and the show. (Drama, Romance, Comedy) - 2010

Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor. (Action, Adventure, Historical drama) - 2011

starzencore.us.title: John Henry
starzencore.us.description: A quiet man with a violent past has his life changed when an immigrant girl who is on the run from gang violence in South Los Angeles stumbles into his life. (Drama, Thriller) - 2020

Even though lives are potentially at stake during every flight, he sees the assignment as just a desk job. However, his "ordinary day at the office" becomes a high-stakes crisis during a flight to London. Marks receives a series of text messages demanding that he instruct the airline to transfer $150 million into an offshore account, or a passenger will die every 20 minutes. (Action, Thriller) - 2014

starzencore.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. (Action, Drama) - 2026

starzencore.us.title: Man of the House
starzencore.us.description: Texas Ranger Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones) follows a strict code of behavior and has no patience for those who don't follow suit. When five cheerleaders -- Anne (Christina Milian), Teresa (Paula Garcés), Evie (Monica Keena), Heather (Vanessa Ferlito) and Barb (Kelli Garner) -- witness a murder, Sharp is assigned to keep them from meeting the same fate. But his assignment requires him to go undercover as their coach and live in their house, and so, some ground rules are in order. (Comedy) - 2005

starzencore.us.title: The Marine
starzencore.us.description: A discharged soldier (John Cena) returns home from Iraq and finds that his wife (Kelly Carlson) has been kidnapped by the gang of a murderous jewel thief (Robert Patrick). Soldier John Triton must use all his military skills to rescue his wife from her ruthless captors. (Action) - 2006

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Happy Endings
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Filmmaker Nicky (Jesse Bradford) offers to track down the son that Mamie (Lisa Kudrow) gave up for adoption nearly two decades before. Meanwhile, Mamie's stepbrother (and the father of her child), Charley (Steve Coogan), along with his boyfriend, Gil, try to find out what became of the sperm Gil donated to a lesbian couple. Finally, singer Jude (Maggie Gyllenhaal) becomes entangled in a love triangle with androgynous drummer Otis (Jason Ritter) and his conservative father (Tom Arnold). (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2005

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2015

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Closing the Ring
starzencoreclassic.us.description: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. In modern-day Belfast, a man named Jimmy (Martin McCann) endeavors to return a ring found in the wreckage of a crashed plane. He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Damsel
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Samuel Alabaster, an affluent pioneer, ventures across the American frontier to marry the love of his life, Penelope. As his group traverses the West, the once-simple journey grows treacherous, blurring the lines between hero, villain and damsel. (Comedy, Western) - 2018

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Blood Surf
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A sleazy producer (Joel West) develops a concept he dubs "blood surfing" -- tossing bloody fish remains into the water to lure sharks and then surfing through the animals as they chomp about. Along with his camerawoman (Kate Fischer), the producer brings two thrill-seeking surfers (Dax Miller, Matt Borlenghi) to the coast of Florida to capture some gnarly footage. But, as they blood surf, they encounter something even more deadly: a colossal prehistoric crocodile intent on devouring them. (Horror) - 2000

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Sleepwalking
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When her boyfriend is arrested for marijuana possession, Joleen Reedy (Charlize Theron) and her 11-year-old daughter, Tara (AnnaSophia Robb), take refuge with Joleen's aimless brother, James (Nick Stahl). Joleen soon runs off with a truck driver, and James is unable to meet his responsibilities. After Child Protective Services takes possession of Tara, James abducts her from a foster home, and the two travel from California to Utah, where his abusive father (Dennis Hopper) lives. (Drama) - 2008

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Crave
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Aiden yearns for a better life and to get away from his grisly job as a crime scene photographer. As his dark imagination leaks into reality, he meets a younger woman with her own problems and begins to live out his vigilante fantasies. (Drama, Thriller) - 2012

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Bad Turn Worse
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Three teens from Texas move out of their small town and get sucked into organized crime when one of them steals from the wrong man. (Crime drama) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: The Gift

A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Phantoms
themoviechannel.us.description: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter

Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child. (Fantasy, Thriller) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Asylum

As the vicious murders continue, Harry teams up with a brilliant recruit to try and lure the madman out of the shadows before he can strike again. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2017

The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crossing Guard
themoviechannel.us.description: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future. (Drama) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver

After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Days of Thunder
themoviechannel.us.description: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (Action, Drama, Romance) - 1990

themoviechannel.us.title: Up in the Air
themoviechannel.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Time Traveler's Wife

On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync. (Romance, Drama, Science fiction) - 2009

The situation creates much tension in the family, and Tita's powerful emotions begin to surface in fantastical ways through her cooking. As the years pass, unusual circumstances test the enduring love of Pedro and Tita. (Romance, Drama, Books & literature) - 1992

His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Steve (real-life boxer Max Baer) is a brash bartender whose knock-out power is discovered by the Professor (Walter Huston), an alcoholic ex-fight trainer. Working together, they find success in the ring, and Steve begins a whirlwind romance with the sultry Belle (Myrna Loy), a gangster's moll who hastily leaves her man to marry him. Steve's infidelity brings discord to their marriage, but he'll have to overcome these distractions if he's going to succeed in his heavyweight title fight. (Comedy) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Men in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Pressured by long hours filled with life-and-death decisions, medical intern George Ferguson (Clark Gable) grows increasingly exhausted and unsure about his career. After a night call forces him to break another date with fiancée Laura Hudson (Myrna Loy), George takes comfort with nursing student Barbara Dennin (Elizabeth Allan) -- unaware that his mentor, Dr. Hochberg (Jean Hersholt), knows of the liaison. Later, when confronted by Barbara's botched abortion, George must decide his future. (Drama) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stamboul Quest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: From within the confines of a mental institution, Annemarie (Myrna Loy) succumbs to memories of her rocky espionage career. As a German agent during World War I, Annemarie travels to Constantinople to gather information on a Turkish military official. Things go smoothly until she encounters an American medical student named Douglas (George Brent) while on her way to the Middle East. As the spy and the student fall in love, deadly consequences result. (Drama) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust. (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Red Pony
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the Salinas Valley of California, young Tom Tiflin lives on his family's ranch with his parents, Fred and Alice, who are constantly at odds, and with his rambling grandfather. Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss. (Adventure) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham. (Comedy drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction. (Comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: So Goes My Love
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn. (Romantic comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Successful Calamity
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After a year away in Europe, successful financier Henry Wilton (George Arliss) is finally returning home to his wife, Emmy (Mary Astor), daughter Peggy (Evalyn Knapp) and son Eddie, only to discover their lifestyle leaves them much too busy to spend any time together as a family. In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up? (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Turn Back the Clock
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife. (Comedy drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Millionaire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Growing bored with life as a retiree, millionaire James Alden (George Arliss) secretly invests in an unprofitable gas station to amuse himself. Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business. (Comedy) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Tycoon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American engineer Johnny Munroe (John Wayne) is hired by South American tycoon Frederick Alexander (Cedric Hardwicke) to bore a tunnel for a new railroad in the Andes Mountains. On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Silver Dollar
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Yates Martin (Edward G. Robinson) and his wife, Sarah (Aline MacMahon), are struggling to make ends meet as owners of a grocery store in late 19th-century Colorado. When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again. (Biography) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The World Changes
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor). (Drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Boom Town
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart. (Adventure) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Enchanted Cottage
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Disfigured from wounds suffered in war, pilot Oliver Bradford (Robert Young) runs away in shame from his beautiful fiancée (Hillary Brooke) and his mother (Spring Byington). Renting a cottage from the kind-hearted Mrs. Minnett (Mildred Natwick), Oliver meets the plain-looking but gentle housekeeper Laura Pennington (Dorothy McGuire). As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within. (Romance) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Desire Me
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise. (Romance) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Great Lie
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer. (Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Random Harvest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Plucky Englishwoman Joan Webster travels to the remote islands of the Scottish Hebrides in order to marry a wealthy industrialist. Trapped by inclement weather on the Isle of Mull and unable to continue to her destination, Joan finds herself charmed by the straightforward, no-nonsense islanders around her, and becomes increasingly attracted to naval officer Torquil MacNeil, who holds a secret that may change her life forever. (Romantic comedy) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dark Victory
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: They Learned About Women
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this musical, friends Jerry Burke (Gus Van) and Jack Glennon (Joseph T. Schenck) are both baseball players who perform a vaudeville act on the side. Jack attracts the attention of money-hungry Daisy (Mary Doran), who splits up his engagement with sweet Mary (Bessie Love) and his friendship with Jerry. Eventually, Jerry's income is insufficient for Daisy, and she leaves him. Jack, whose team is playing in the World Series, starts dating Mary, but still tries to help his old friend in need. (Musical) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Alibi Ike
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: With his job on the line, Chicago Cubs manager Cap (William Frawley) needs to turn around his lackluster team fast -- especially since nothing less than the pennant will keep him employed. Fortunately for Cap, rookie pitcher Frank "Ike" Farrell (Joe E. Brown) has just the talent to pull up the fledgling team. However, Ike always has an excuse or a lie handy for every problem -- and the real trouble comes when a group of gamblers looks to fix the Cubs' games, and Ike is their main target. (Comedy) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Big Leaguer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young players try out for the founder (Edward G. Robinson) of the New York Giants Florida training camp. (Drama) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Pride of the Yankees
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This moving biographical drama follows the life of revered baseball player Lou Gehrig (Gary Cooper). Championed by sportswriter Sam Blake (Walter Brennan), Gehrig eventually gets recruited by the New York Yankees, joining a team of heavy hitters that includes the legendary Babe Ruth. When Gehrig marries his spirited sweetheart, Eleanor (Teresa Wright), things look up for him, but he is soon sidelined by a terrible illness that he bravely tries to battle. (Biography) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Winning Team
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1908 Nebraska, young Grover Cleveland Alex Alexander (Ronald Reagan) saves to buy a farm for himself and his fiancée, Aimee (Doris Day), but also longs to realize his dream of playing baseball. His pitching skills win him a position on an Illinois team, but an injury almost ruins his chance. Once he recovers, he and Aimee wed, and he returns to baseball and begins an increasingly successful career -- until he's diagnosed with epilepsy, which he struggles to hide from the public and Aimee. (Romance, Biography, Docudrama) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Angels in the Outfield
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A newspaper reporter, Jennifer Paige (Janet Leigh), is investigating the Pittsburgh Pirates' losing streak. The team is led by manager Guffy McGovern (Paul Douglas), whose swearing and fighting hinder his team's progress. Meanwhile, an orphan named Bridget White (Donna Corcoran) has been praying for the team, and her pleas are answered by an angelic voice. The angel begins urging Guffy to be kinder in return for helping the Pirates win, but the playoffs test the manager's temper. (Children, Comedy) - 1951

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E12 Slipping On The Goodship Feathersword Join The Wiggles on the SS Feathersword for a fun-filled sea adventure where Captain, Lachy, and Simon spill water due to rough seas. It's time to call Billy Bobbin, the mopping specialist, for a solution!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E10 The Spider Bitzer decides to pamper himself with a relaxing bath while the Farmer is away from the farm. However, his plans are rudely disturbed by a persistent intruder. Will Shaun be able to out-smart the tenacious bug?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Adventures of Paddington
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E15 Paddington's Race Against The Storm Judy finds her inner hero when a storm hits on a Rangers Camping trip, and they need to shelter from the weather.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Ultron Ruins Valentine's Day / The Iron Friends and the Trouble at the Tar Pits The trio must save the mammoth exhibit when Swarm and Absorbing Man cause chaos at the tar pit museum.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Knee High Spies
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Mission Shhh! Jeremy and Deena need to sneak into the playroom and shut down Glitch's Noise Maker machine before it wakes cousin Milo from his afternoon nap.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Itsy-Bitsy Spiders Doc Ock shrinks Spidey, Ghost-Spider and Spin down to the size of actual spiders!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Vida the Vet
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Sunny's Baby Sister Surprise When Sunny meets his new baby sister, he's disappointed that she's too little to play.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Ghost Pumpkin Flower and Unicorn Cuzzy decide to create creepy faces on pumpkins for the Spooky Night Party coming up. But they freak out when one of their pumpkins seems to come to life!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E13 Holding The Baby Peppa and George are pretending to hold babies while Mummy and Daddy Pig look after Evie. They ask if Peppa wants to hold Evie, but Peppa decides to practice first.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Hospital Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy, leaving Bluey no choice but to operate immediately!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E29 Fuzzy Eaters The Broccolisaurus need a haircut. Luckily, their florets are a Pea-Rex's favourite snack!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Meet The Gherkinns Gherkinn's family visits Kangaroo Beach, eager to see their heroic lifeguard son in action! But when they arrive, they discover Ghërkinn hasn't been entirely truthful with them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 The Ice Phoenix Clarion and Annette learn the joy of giving while helping Dr. Talon with a special patient.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mojo Swoptops
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Mojo Rocks Big rocks block Ted's way, but Mojo's mighty dozer top can save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Andy and the Flamingos Mr Hammond has painted a picture of some flamingos and asks Andy to look after it. But Andy accidentally spills blue paint all over the painting! Andy heads to the Andes to find some flamingos and make a replacement painting.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E7 Green Team: 2 Alex and Emma tell the story of a platypus getting food for her babies, and Kiya and Jemima walk amongst the mangroves. Craig Reucassel dials in to talk about ocean oil spills. Through The Windows we see some seahorses!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S15 E17 A Day with Scoop Dooley Sarah and Mandy are filming a piece for the Scoop Dooley Show, and Scoop Dooley is trying to make everything more 'sensational.'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Riff's Present Riff is trying to make a video for her mom, but the Sprouts keep interrupting with their noisy circus practice! Will Riff ever get her video done?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Wonky Carrots When Ellie digs up a carrot, she's disappointed to discover it's all wonky. Together, the Woohoos work out how some carrots grow wonkily - and that being wonky doesn't stop it being a juicy, delicious carrot!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 Pumpkin Patch A fun, spooky tale from little White Owl leaves the friends a little on edge. So when they hear strange noises in the pumpkin patch, they wonder what kind of creepy creature might be lurking there with them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E59 Ko's New Game Miffy and her friends get together for Dodgeball club. But Miffy realizes that Ko isn't really a fan of the game.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Rewilding The Sound Collector gets help from a friend when he finds trees that have been cut down.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 The Kibble Corners Toy Drive Pants is very excited for his Aunt Chiffon to visit. He has a whole tour of Kibble Corners planned. But when she has to stay inside because of allergies, he takes the tour digital.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 MeMo Dog BaBa makes friends with a Tweetie and MeMo bonds closely with a new toy, MeMo Dog.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Fantus Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 The Balloons The children and Fantus play with a ball and tunnel, then Fantus sings with a sea otter on a boar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready Eddie Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Eddie's Haircut Eddie prepares for his first haircut by discovering that all the sensory experiences at a hairdresser's can be fun.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Trampoline When Dad has to stop having fun with the girls and go to work, Bluey and Bingo scramble to keep him playing games with them on the trampoline!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E7 Tunnels Fizzy and Suds head underground to explore glow-in-the-dark art, hidden passageways, and tunnel-boring machines. But they're not boring; they're exciting!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Kids Only Gen, Pia and Romeo are bursting with garden knowledge and are ready to go solo: no grown ups allowed! They draw a planting plan, grab their gloves and get in the dirt. The kids have got it covered - no help is needed.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Episode 33 Get ready for some Halloween fun! Sing, dress Up and enjoy your favourite Halloween songs, plus some craft-time fun!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Ultron Ruins Valentine's Day / The Iron Friends and the Trouble at the Tar Pits The trio must save the mammoth exhibit when Swarm and Absorbing Man cause chaos at the tar pit museum.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Where There's A Wheel There's A Way Sif's coming in for a landing at the rocket launch site, but when her rocket gets pushed off course she needs the Mecha Builders!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S24 E3 The Great Little Railway Show When a Railway Show for little engines comes to Sodor, an overly excited Percy finally sees his chance to shine.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E46 George's Balloon George finds it difficult to keep hold of his big dinosaur balloon, and everyone is afraid that it will float away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E21 Pirate Treasure Pirate Peppa and friends put together a chest of treasure and bury it in a marked spot. Soon Pedro needs to follow the trail as he realises he has lost something.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E9 Air Kiri has to hold her breath at an underwater party and realises how much she loves air.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E8 Smell You Later Ginger and the Peas meet the stinky Onion-Rexes who help stop the nasty Bananaraptors.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Elf School Holly and Nanny Plum join Ben at Elf School, where the Wise Old Elf tells them that strictly no magic should be used. All the Elf children are very good at building their toys.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Vida the Vet
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E51 Zigzag's Skunk Spray 'Tis a stinky scene when Zigzag's skunk friend mistakenly sprays her. Enter Vida's special soap!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 High Stakes Tom throws a dumpster into space to impress others, but must catch it to prevent disaster as it falls back to Earth.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 The Golden Banana Treasure Santi and crew navigate the tricky Banana Island to save a baby monkey and its treasure from Enrique.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Heroes of Iceworld Part II Romeo has stolen the Ice Crystal. And Icecub lose his Powers!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 The Octonauts and the Scared Sperm Whale A timid sperm whale must conquer his fears and dive deep down to help the Octonauts release Peso from a giant clam.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 The Hair Badge Duggee is having a bad hair day. Can the Squirrels help him at all? They've got lots of ideas and lots of things to try out. Norrie knows what to do so she goes first, but Duggee lets them all have a go.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Meet The Gherkinns Gherkinn's family visits Kangaroo Beach, eager to see their heroic lifeguard son in action! But when they arrive, they discover Ghërkinn hasn't been entirely truthful with them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Nikhil and Jay and the Wriggly Worries When Jay finds a worm in the garden, the family decide to have a worm charming championship! Nikhil's not so sure about worms. He has a spot of wriggly worries and doesn't want to take part.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Cat Whisperer Mayor Sourdough is going to build a cat playground for the kittens, but he realizes he doesn't know what kittens like. He gets Mittens to show him what being a cat is all about.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Make and Create
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S374 E2 Curious Thinkers Special guest Maddie joins Emma and Kaeng to experiment with different shapes to build a colourful cardboard castle. They test a Roly Poly Musical Masterpiece, and Kaeng shows us around his spectacular sculpture garden!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Fairy Tales Join The Wiggles in a joyful celebration as we say a big \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Bees Fizzy and Suds meet a bee and follow it home to it's hive! They watch bees collect nectar, make honey, protect the hive, and care for babies - all in their buzzing bee kingdom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Lil' stompers ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 L'il Time Alone Bertie's friends are confused when she wants alone time instead of playing with them. But they soon discover she's been working on a special project for her friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E2 Baby Banana Ginger and the Peas reluctantly babysit a mischievous Baby Bananaraptor that proves to be more than a handful.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E32 Pest-Proof Time Machine Cockatoo eating your fig tree? Never fear! The junior gardeners have some genius ways to pest proof your garden!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E40 Tina's New Friend While trying to stop Bonnie Bones, Tina accidentally gets separated and makes a new friend in the form of an ancient robot!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E34 Pretend Piano Player When Mr. Puppypaws pretends Poochissimo's piano playing is his own, the SuperKitties set out to reveal the truth.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E43 The Looking After Badge Phileas Frog and Flea start their expedition around the world in a hot air balloon, leaving behind Pippin, their potted plant! But how will the squirrels look after the plant? Don't worry Duggee has his Looking After badge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E32 Tradies Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E14 Hoops At Peppa's playgroup Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout using hoops that you spin around your waist.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E15 The Park Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park where they meet their friends, swing on the monkey bars, bounce on a bouncy branch and end with lots of muddy puddles.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E16 Camouflage In a game of Hide and Seek, Kiri pretends to be a flower.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 A Big Day Out for D.O.R.I.S Dad gets trapped in the shower when D.O.R.I.S. decides to visit the sea. Can Big Lizard and Cosima stop her before she does herself some permanent damage?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 The Octonauts and the Narwhal While exploring the Arctic, the Octonauts' ship, the Octopod, gets trapped in the ice. Only Barnacle's skillful navigation - and the help of a friendly Narwhal - can get them free.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 Little Trev's Turtle Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Oh My, Pizza Pie The Super Monsters help Chef Luigi prepare and deliver 20 pizzas, using teamwork and their powers to master pizza-making and learn the value of collaboration.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E7 Sand Trapped Team Spidey gets trapped in Sandman's giant sand maze.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E33 Granny Mobile Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny on an old mobility scooter at a garage sale, but a real granny wants to buy it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Ghost Pumpkin Flower and Unicorn Cuzzy decide to create creepy faces on pumpkins for the Spooky Night Party coming up. But they freak out when one of their pumpkins seems to come to life!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 The New Wand Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill, Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Follow The Herd Ariel learns to stand up to his parents while helping his family's unicorn herd.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E51 Waltzing Potato Evil Pea plans to freeze Supertato into an ice cube by pretending to teach him to dance.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Secret Origin of the Batwheels Part 3 The newly-minted Batwheels must defend the Batcave! Part 3.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 The Dump On a trip to the Dump Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E15 The Piano The Farmer is playing the piano and torturing everyone with his musical inability! When the Flock discover that Bitzer is a virtuoso they decide it's time for a party. They devise a plan to 'borrow' the piano from the Farmer.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E10 The Corridor of Elders The Ninja and fighters discover there's a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Che's Anacondrai army. but their forces still aren't strong enough.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E11 A Lock-In, a Weather Girl and a Disgusting Habit Sheldon acts as Mary's spy when he's forced to spend the night at church for a youth lock-in. Meanwhile, Georgie finds himself attracted to an older woman named Mandy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak ᴺᵉʷ

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E12 A Pink Cadillac And A Glorious Tribal Dance Sheldon attends his first comic book convention and Mary tries selling make-up.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Animal Park ᴺᵉʷ

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kids Baking Championship

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E16 Episode 16 Gerardo Lopez joins Laura in the market to make his Mexican staple, Guacamole,with a brilliant left-of-field twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Lamb Chops With Rice And Spinach Rachael prepares a well-rounded meal featuring a French-cut rack of lamb baked with Dijon mustard and seasoned breadcrumbs, accompanied by a side dish of brown and wild rice with porcini mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E10 Cudgen It's our season finale this week, and Hayden is back in the NSW Northern Rivers to check out a paddock to plate farm where he stocks up on some super fresh organic produce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Episode 6 We get a little indulgent with Thomas Schnetzler's decadent chunky, chewy Choc Chip Cookie Tart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E11 Episode 11 of Season 9 The chefs cook hanger steak with chimichurri sauce, olive salad. prawn risoni and roasted pumpkin with a twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 Episode 9 Rick pays a memorable visit to the Channel Island of Jersey, where he goes reef fishing for sea bass, which he grills.He also makes a Consomme and enjoys a beach barbecue.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E40 Episode 40 Today's episode is full of incredible recipes including Meatloaf in Smoky Barbecue Sauce, Waffles and a Mint and Coriander Chutney.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E73 Weeknight Gold Ready the dinner podium, because Adam, hatted chef Alejandro Saravia and swimming sensation Ariarne Titmus are on the quest for weeknight gold.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Pastry Delicious pastry is the order of the day in this programme. Jamie shows us how to make a simple, short crust pastry that is versatile for sweet or savoury dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E12 Here I Come New York! As a teenager, Lidia took charge of most dinners at home, soups being a popular choice. In this episode, she makes potato and pasta soup, polenta with honey and berries, and uses leftover polenta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Goats Cheese Will Studd journeys to the village of Sainte Maure de Touraine to attend the annual Goats Cheese fair. In the Judge's Hall, he finds out what to look for in a perfect chevre.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Menu Four Mark brings flavours from around the globe, using ingredients you're likely to have in your fridge and store cupboard. He cooks lamb kofte, salted caramel custard pots, and slow-cooked meatballs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Simple Classics Lorraine makes simple and classic recipes that have stood the test of time. From a twist on an Italian favourite, salmon saltimbocca with gremolata potatoes and crispy sage leaves to pan fried gnocci.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 All About Meat Sophie explores how her Puglian neighbours eat and cook meat. She makes orecchiette pasta with meatballs, then visits her neighbour's countryside plot to cook pasta al forno and bombette.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Ali & Mitch Torres: Birriga Birriga (Pippies) Soup & Goolil (Turtle) Chilli Tamarind Sambal Heading out to Roebuck Bay, Ali and Mitch hit up a childhood local that's always come through with plenty of shellfish, fish, and turtle for the family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Orchard Maggie shows how to make a wonderful peach jam, sharing a new method to check when it is ready to set, makes a simple peach and prosciutto salad and finishes with a peach drink.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E17 Episode 17 Laura's prep chef Gabby joins her on set to make a winter comfort dish, Pasta Pantry Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 Skirt Steak With Salsa Verde Rachael's friend, author Anna Gass, demonstrates how to make an Italian potato and horseradish frittata, a traditional snack from the Basilicata region of Italy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S7 E1 Coff Coast Hayden Quinn kicks off the season on the Coffs Coast, where coastal beauty meets rich farmland. He gets in a surf, enjoys some blueberries, learns to make cheese and discovers why this region is a gem.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Episode 7 Cherie Hausler serves up a fragrant Whole Mandarin Cake with crunchy Poppy Seed Icing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E12 Episode 12 of Season 9 Laura puts a spin on a classic with an indulgent Tiramisu Brownie. Catherine Velisha makes a dish that is both veggie focussed and inspired by her grandparents, Cypriot Onion.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Episode 10 Rick takes a moonlit excursion off Newlyn Bay in Cornwall to go pilchard fishing with Nick Howell. Pilchards are not popular in Britain, as they tend to come smothered in tomato sauce in tins.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E41 Episode 41 Guest Melissa Leong joins Justine on today's show where she makes her Sticky Rice Lotus Parcels. Justine shows you her twist on a classic guacamole dip as well as her Prawn Po Boy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E74 Waste Not One-Pot If you hate food waste and washing up, you're in for a treat, because Adam and his guests, chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao are making waste not one-pot recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Episode 4 Eva is all about cosy, soul-satisfying dishes in this episode. She starts with Chinese Baked Pork Chop Rice, a nostalgic, hearty dish layered with tender pork, fluffy rice, and a rich sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Richard Roxburgh Actor Richard Roxburgh revisits his mother's creative influence on his acting career as chef Matt Moran recreates her iconic Beggar's Chicken, a unique school sandwich.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Wisconsin Tony travels to his home state of Wisconsin for a family gathering and explores its hidden gems; visiting a craft brewery and a local dairy farm.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Atlanta 36 hours in Atlanta, The ATL. Tony drives a muscle car then indulges in an old favourite, Fat Matt's Rib Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E74 Waste Not One-Pot If you hate food waste and washing up, you're in for a treat, because Adam and his guests, chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao are making waste not one-pot recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E13 Cooking As A Kid In New York Lidia starts off with lasagna with ricotta and mozzarella, then she makes a flavourful escarole olive oil mashed potatoes, and finishes with baked stuffed vegetables.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Parmigiano / Reggiano Parmigiano Reggiano is the undisputed king of Italian cheese and is still made by hand the old fashioned way in giant copper cauldrons, in the beautiful countryside near Parma in Reggio Emilia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Menu Five Mark creates three recipes inspired by holidays and the warmer months - ratatouille tart, a pineapple tipsy cake and his go-to one-pot fish stew with crunchy sourdough croutons.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Baking It Baking isn't all about breads and cakes as Lorraine shows in tonight's episode.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Pasta: The Stuff Of Life Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Dwes Wiggin - Dann: Chilli Fish & Mango Cheesecake With Bush Passionfruit Topping Dwes cooks a favourite dish shared with him by one of his Aunties, and gives the Malaysian chilli fish dish a local twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Brunch Maggie has happily been up at the crack of dawn to collect the fresh eggs, and extols the virtue of happy chooks and free range eggs. Simon brings her a present to try out, a white truffle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E18 Episode 18 Laura cooks a fabulous Lemon Tiramisu in the beautiful Adelaide Hills.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E21 Inferno: Episode 3 Transported to a parallel world, the Doctor discovers that England is under military rule and the drilling project is at a more advanced stage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E22 Inferno: Episode 4 In the parallel world, the drilling project is about to penetrate the Earth’s crust. The Doctor, arrested as a spy, is unable to convince his captors of the danger that faces them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E23 Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E5 The Mind of Evil: Episode 1 At Stangmoor Prison, the Doctor and Jo watch a demonstration of the Keller Machine which can extract evil impulses from criminals. But the experiment goes wrong and a man dies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E6 The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E17 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 6 On board a vast spacecraft, the Doctor meets the alien captain who demands the return of the three ambassadors sent to Earth or he will destroy the world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E18 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 7 General Carrington is behind the kidnapping of the ambassadors and intends to turn the world against the aliens by revealing their true identity to the world in a TV broadcast.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E19 Inferno: Episode 1 UNIT are at a project run by Professor Stahlman who intends to penetrate Earth’s crust. But the drilling has already released something deadly from beneath the Earth’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E8 The Mind of Evil: Episode 4 The mind parasite within the Keller Machine becomes too powerful for the Master to control. It learns how to move of its own accord and goes on the hunt for new minds.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E9 The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E10 The Mind of Evil: Episode 6 The Keller Machine breaks free of the Doctor’s restraining device and the Doctor has no choice but to turn the parasite against the Master.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E11 The Claws of Axos: Episode 1 Axos lands on Earth. The Axons ask only to be allowed to repair their damaged ship and offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite in return. But the Axons aren’t all that they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E12 The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E13 The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E14 The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E15 Colony in Space: Episode 1 The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Jo to a barren world in the far future where human colonists are scratching a living. But at night, the colonists are menaced by a monster.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E16 Colony in Space: Episode 2 The Interplanetary Mining Corporation, represented by Captain Dent, arrives on the planet claiming that the colonists have no right to be there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E17 Colony in Space: Episode 3 When Jo attempts to break into the IMC ship to find incriminating information, she is captured and held hostage. If the Doctor doesn’t cooperate, Captain Dent will have Jo killed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E18 Colony in Space: Episode 4 The Master arrives, posing as an adjudicator from Earth who has come to settle the dispute between the colonists and the miners. However, the Master has an agenda of his own.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E19 Colony in Space: Episode 5 With Jo held prisoner in his TARDIS, the Master forces the Doctor to take him to the underground city of the primitives. Any sign of treachery from the Doctor and Jo will die.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E20 Colony in Space: Episode 6 In the underground city, the Doctor and the Master confront the guardian of the doomsday weapon. The miners make their last move to force the colonists to leave the planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E21 The Daemons: Episode 1 The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow near the village of Devil’s End. Posing as the village vicar, the Master summons dark forces.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
