kdsm.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
kdsm.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kdsm.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ

She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

syfy.us.title: Scary Movie
syfy.us.description: Defying the very notion of good taste, Scary Movie out-parodies the pop culture parodies with a no-holds barred assault on the most popular images and talked-about moments from recent films, television and commercials. The film boldly fires barbs at the classic scenes from Scream, The Sixth Sense, The Matrix, I Know What You Did Last Summer and The Blair Witch Project, then goes on to mock a whole myriad of teen movie clichés, no matter the genre. (Comedy, Horror) - 2000

syfy.us.title: Scary Movie 2
syfy.us.description: All the scary movie characters are back in a laugh packed sequel that scares up even more irreverent fun than the original. Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris lead a stellar cast that takes extreme pleasure in skewering Hollywood's most frightening feature films and spoofing popular culture. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit. (Comedy, Horror) - 2001

syfy.us.title: Pixels

syfy.us.title: The Final Girls

wfft.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wofl.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wofl.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

fxm.us.description: Working in the shadow of his father, Detective Ezekiel "Zeke" Banks and his rookie partner take charge of an investigation into grisly murders that are eerily reminiscent of the city's gruesome past. Unwittingly entrapped in a deepening mystery, Zeke finds himself at the center of the killer's morbid game. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Black Rose
fxm.us.description: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England. (Adventure) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Berlin Correspondent
fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government. (Thriller) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Decision Before Dawn
fxm.us.description: During World War II, an American intelligence unit led by Col. Devlin (Gary Merrill) is recruiting German prisoners of war to infiltrate enemy lines and gather vital information. Lt. Rennick (Richard Basehart) heads a unit of Germans that includes the mistrustful "Tiger" (Hans Christian Blech) and the wide-eyed "Happy" (Oskar Werner). When word arrives that a German general is about to negotiate the surrender of his corps, Devlin sends Rennick and his volunteers on a dangerous mission. (Drama, War, Thriller) - 1951

fxm.us.title: Hell and High Water
fxm.us.description: Mercenary sub commander, Captain Adam Jones (Richard Widmark), sells his services to noted atomic scientist Professor Montel (Victor Francen) and his daughter, Denise (Bella Darvi). Professor Montel is convinced the Communists are about to launch a nuclear attack on Korea from an island in the Arctic and blame it on the United States. Captain Jones does not care about politics, but the earnest Professor and his supporters win him over to their cause, and they try to thwart the Communists' plans. (Adventure) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Quiller Memorandum
fxm.us.description: After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group. (Thriller) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Kremlin Letter
fxm.us.description: When an unauthorized letter is sent to Moscow alleging the U.S. government's willingness to help Russia attack China, former naval officer Charles Rone and his team are sent to retrieve it. They go undercover, successfully reaching out to Erika Kosnov, the wife of a former agent, now married to the head of Russia's secret police. Their plans are interrupted, however, when their Moscow hideout is raided by a cunning politician. (Thriller) - 1970

Shaw hopes that they will meet a race of benevolent, godlike beings who will in some way verify her religious beliefs, while Holloway is out to debunk any spiritual notions. However, neither the scientists nor their shipmates are prepared for the unimaginable terrors that await them. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2012

While there, they meet David (Michael Fassbender), the synthetic survivor of the doomed Prometheus expedition. The mysterious world soon turns dark and dangerous when a hostile alien life-form forces the crew into a deadly fight for survival. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2017

fxm.us.title: Ad Astra
fxm.us.description: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into deep space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son -- a fearless astronaut -- must embark on a daring mission to Neptune to uncover the truth about his missing father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the stability of the universe. (Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller) - 2019

fxm.us.title: Machete

Hired to perform a covert hit, he is double-crossed and forced to go on the run. Machete may be down, but not out, and he carves a path of blood, bullets and broken hearts in his quest to settle the score. (Action) - 2010

fxm.us.title: Blood and Sand

Bidding his childhood sweetheart Carmen (Linda Darnell) farewell, Juan and his friends travel to Madrid to learn the bullfighting craft. Years later, when Juan's fame as a matador soars, he returns to Seville to marry Carmen. Soon, Juan's head is turned by the elegant temptress Doña Sol De Muira (Rita Hayworth), and his career takes a turn. (Drama) - 1941

fxm.us.title: Down Argentine Way

Carrol Naish), objects because of a long-standing grudge against the Crawfords. bbcamerica.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Christine
bbcamerica.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

bbcamerica.us.title: Halloween
bbcamerica.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

bbcamerica.us.title: Child's Play
bbcamerica.us.description: Gunned down by Detective Mike Norris (Chris Sarandon), dying murderer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) uses black magic to put his soul inside a doll named Chucky -- which Karen Barclay (Catherine Hicks) then buys for her young son, Andy (Alex Vincent). When Chucky kills Andy's babysitter, the boy realizes the doll is alive and tries to warn people, but he's institutionalized. Now Karen must convince the detective of the murderous doll's intentions, before Andy becomes Chucky's next victim. (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 1988

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Seed
bbcamerica.us.description: The probe of a woman's attempt on her husband's life leads to a fertility doctor with a high rate of success. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-02-15

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Wannabe
bbcamerica.us.description: Expelled from an exclusive boys school, an underprivileged youth, a gifted student, is suspected of a trustee's murder. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-03-15

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Act of God
bbcamerica.us.description: When an explosion at a construction site kills a boy, McCoy and Kincaid try to exonerate a demolitions expert wrongly convicted of the crime. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-03-22

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Privileged
bbcamerica.us.description: The stabbing murder of a husband and wife prompts Briscoe and Logan to investigate Steven Bartlett, an alcoholic who was abused as a child. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-04-05

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Cruel and Unusual
bbcamerica.us.description: After learning controversial therapy may have caused an autistic's death, McCoy must discredit the main witness. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-04-19

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Bad Faith
bbcamerica.us.description: The death of a fellow detective and childhood friend forces Logan to deal with repressed memories about the school he attended. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-04-26

bbcamerica.us.title: Earth's Great Seasons - Spring
bbcamerica.us.description: Àngels Barceló shows us how spring comes to our planet, from bear cubs to flowers in the desert. In addition, we discovered how animals face the challenges of this season. (Nature, Documentary) - 2017-06-09

bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Endless Blue
bbcamerica.us.description: A large part of the remote, blue wilderness of the South Pacific is a marine desert, in which many animals go to extraordinary lengths to survive. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-05-24

bbcamerica.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
bbcamerica.us.description: Soon after their showdown with evil spirits that possessed their son, the Lamberts, Renai and Josh, are ready for their lives to return to normal. However, something still is seriously off, especially with Josh, who -- unbeknown to Renai -- is possessed too. In order to free Josh's soul and finally defeat the malevolent forces around them, Lorraine Lambert and her ghost-hunting friends investigate the past to save her family's future. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
bbcamerica.us.description: When teenager Quinn Brenner (Stefanie Scott) senses that her late mother is trying to contact her, she seeks help from gifted psychic Elise Rainier (Lin Shaye). However, Elise's tragic past makes her reluctant to use her abilities. After Quinn is attacked by a malevolent entity, her father (Dermot Mulroney) pleads with Elise for help. With support from two parapsychologists, Elise ventures deep into The Further -- where she finds a powerful demon with an insatiable craving for human souls. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

bbcamerica.us.title: The Haunting in Connecticut
bbcamerica.us.description: When their son Matt (Kyle Gallner) receives a diagnosis of cancer, Sara (Virginia Madsen) and Peter (Martin Donovan) Campbell move to Connecticut to be closer to his doctors. At first all is well, but then Matt becomes increasingly disturbed by what appears to be paranormal activity. Sara turns to a priest for help, and the ghosts are seemingly banished -- but Matt's condition takes a sudden and unexplained turn for the worse, and the lives of Sara and the rest of her family are endangered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

bbcamerica.us.title: The Amityville Horror
bbcamerica.us.description: When George Lutz (Ryan Reynolds) and his wife, Kathy (Melissa George), find a beautiful new house in the small town of Amityville, N.Y., they think the place is too good to be true. After they move in with their kids, they find out the cheap price tag is thanks to the house's sordid history: The former tenant murdered his family after supposedly being possessed by the devil. Believing the home is haunted, the couple find a priest (Philip Baker Hall) to help them rid the place of evil spirits. (Horror) - 2005

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Carrie
bbcamerica.us.description: High school can be tough for many teenagers, but for Carrie White (Chloë Grace Moretz), it's especially hellish. A shy and awkward teen being raised by a religious zealot (Julianne Moore), Carrie is frequently the target of bullies. But Carrie has a secret talent: She can make things move with her mind. One fateful night, an especially cruel prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge, and Carrie unleashes her telekinetic powers on all who get in her way. (Horror) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
bbcamerica.us.description: Fifteen years after Hansel (Jeremy Renner) and Gretel (Gemma Arterton) defeated the wicked witch who planned to have them for her dinner, the siblings have come of age as skilled bounty hunters. Hell-bent on retribution, they have dedicated their lives to hunting down and destroying every witch still lurking in the dark forests of their homeland. As the notorious blood moon approaches, the siblings face a great evil -- one that could hold the secret to their terrifying past. (Fantasy, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
bbcamerica.us.description: Murderous ghoul Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) has slaughtered every last child in his hometown. He ventures on to a new location, scouting fresh young victims to hack up with his finger blades. He arrives in a small town in which his long-lost daughter, Maggie (Lisa Zane), works as a therapist for troubled youths. Furthermore, he attempts to recruit her for his dastardly pursuits, but she has other ideas. Father and daughter meet for a bloody showdown that will determine Freddy's fate once and for all. (Horror) - 1991

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Addams Family
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Members of the mysterious and spooky Addams Family -- Gomez, Morticia, Pugsley, Wednesday, Uncle Fester and Grandma -- are readily preparing for a visit from their even creepier relatives. But trouble soon arises when shady TV personality Margaux Needler realizes that the Addams' eerie hilltop mansion is standing in the way of her dream to sell all the houses in the neighborhood. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Sing
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Dapper Koala Buster Moon presides over a once-grand theater that has fallen on hard times. An eternal optimist, and a bit of a scoundrel, he loves his theater above all and will do anything to preserve it. Facing the crumbling of his life's ambition, he takes one final chance to restore his fading jewel to its former glory by producing the world's greatest singing competition. Five contestants emerge: a mouse, a timid elephant, a pig, a gorilla and a punk-rock porcupine. (Animated, Children, Musical comedy) - 2016

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Addams Family 2
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Hoping to get closer as a family, Gomez, Morticia and the rest of the Addams clan embark on an adventurous road trip in a hideous and humongous camper. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2021

retroplex.us.title: The Stranger
retroplex.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret. (Thriller) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Oath of Vengeance
retroplex.us.description: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Overland Riders
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Rustlers
retroplex.us.description: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Wild Country
retroplex.us.description: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Thunder Town
retroplex.us.description: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.description: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives. (Western) - 1934

After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). showtimewest.us.title: Magic Mike
showtimewest.us.description: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

showtimewest.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimewest.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimewest.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtimewest.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtimewest.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtimewest.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtimewest.us.title: It Follows
showtimewest.us.description: Following a strange sexual encounter, a teenager (Maika Monroe) has disturbing visions and the inescapable feeling that someone -- or something -- is stalking her.

showtimewest.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimewest.us.description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

showtimewest.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimewest.us.description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

showtimewest.us.title: The Saint
showtimewest.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

showtimewest.us.title: Congo
showtimewest.us.description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

showtimewest.us.title: She's Out of My League
showtimewest.us.description: An airport security agent must figure out how to make the relationship work when a beautiful, successful woman falls in love with him.

showtimewest.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimewest.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

showtimewest.us.title: The Dutchman
showtimewest.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway.

showtimewest.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtimewest.us.description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

showtimewest.us.title: Ghost in the Shell

tastemade.us.description: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
tastemade.us.description: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens. (Cooking) - 2025-10-01

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
tastemade.us.description: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemade.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemade.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemade.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Fast Paced Roman Recipes
tastemade.us.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemade.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Special Occasion Menus
tastemade.us.description: Gordon teaches us how to cook for special occasions, including stuffed lamb with spinach and pine nuts, Vietnamese-style fresh prawn rolls and a sumptuous whole sea bass stuffed with fennel, lemon and capers. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Baking 101
tastemade.us.description: Gordon turns his focus to home baking. Recipes include his flavor-packed olive, tomato and rosemary focaccia, quick flatbreads with lemon, thyme and ricotta and a spectacular sponge with fresh ginger. (Cooking) - 2024-06-10

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Stress Free Cooking
tastemade.us.description: Gordon's tackles stress-free cooking with recipes including sticky pork ribs, meatballs four ways and an amazing chilli chicken with ginger and coriander that just gets better and better with time. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
tastemade.us.description: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - The Wonderful World of Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pasta From Scratch
tastemade.us.description: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pancake Stacks and Snacks for Two
tastemade.us.description: Frankie flips the script for his wife Heather making breakfast for dinner featuring Banana Maple Pancakes, Eggs Benedict with prosciutto cotto, Home Fries with Bloody Mary Ketchup, Sausage Scrapple, and a boozy Espresso Milkshake. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
tastemade.us.description: Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Lunch That Goes the Distance
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - No Kitchen No Problem
tastemade.us.description: Just because you're dorm living, road tripping, motel living, or haven't gotten that bachelor pad in shape yet, doesn't mean you can't make tasty meals from some handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem. (Cooking) - 2020-03-13

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Crunchy
tastemade.us.description: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget. (Cooking) - 2021-03-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Hot Dishes
tastemade.us.description: You say hot dishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hot dishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals. (Cooking) - 2019-08-22

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Breakfast for Dinner
tastemade.us.description: It's dinnertime and breakfast is on the menu this week. These affordable breakfast specials are hearty enough for dinner, and so delicious they may even taste better after dark. Grab a fork and dig in for the most important meal of the day! (Cooking) - 2023-11-24

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - The Weekly Struggle Budget

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spring Fling

Using a small-town CPA office as a cover, he makes his living as a freelance accountant for dangerous criminal organizations. With a Treasury agent (J.K. Simmons) hot on his heels, Christian takes on a state-of-the-art robotics company as a legitimate client. As Wolff gets closer to the truth about a discrepancy that involves millions of dollars, the body count starts to rise. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama) - 2016

tntwest.us.title: The Shawshank Redemption
tntwest.us.description: Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) is sentenced to two consecutive life terms in prison for the murders of his wife and her lover and is sentenced to a tough prison. However, only Andy knows he didn't commit the crimes. While there, he forms a friendship with Red (Morgan Freeman), experiences brutality of prison life, adapts, helps the warden, etc., all in 19 years. (Drama) - 1994

tntwest.us.title: Air Force One

When a group of terrorists led by Ivan Korshunov hijacks the flight, the President's principles are put to the test. Feigning escape, ex-soldier Marshall stows away in the aircraft and must race against time to rescue his family and everyone else on board. (Thriller, Action) - 1997

tntwest.us.title: The Fugitive
tntwest.us.description: Wrongfully accused of murdering his wife, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find her killer and clear his name. Pursuing him is a team of U.S. marshals led by Deputy Samuel Gerard, a determined detective who will not rest until Richard is captured. As Richard leads the team through a series of intricate chases, he discovers the secrets behind his wife's death and struggles to expose the killer before it is too late. (Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

bbcearth.us.title: 24 Hours on Earth - Night
bbcearth.us.description: The sun's light, reflected in the moon, acts as light for hunting tarsiers and an aphrodisiac for Australian corals. (Episode, Series, Nature, Documentary) - 20140318

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies - Safari Babies
bbcearth.us.description: The great plains of Africa are home to some of the most iconic animals on the planet. Growing up here means safari babies face immense challenges that will really test them. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Animals) - 20161002

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies - Water Babies
bbcearth.us.description: Many animals that live in water come on land to have their babies. Being born this way presents some major challenges for water babies to overcome. For some, simply getting to water in the first place can be the biggest trial of their young lives. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Animals) - 20161009

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies - Mountain Babies
bbcearth.us.description: Mountains are some of the most challenging places for animals to live. Mountain babies must battle extreme weather and hungry predators. With food difficult to find, they have to work hard for every mouthful. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Animals) - 20161016

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses - Sight
bbcearth.us.description: Exploring the extraordinary sense of sight in the animal world; Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how caribou use ultraviolet light to avoid wolves. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Science, Animals) - 20140819

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses - Sound
bbcearth.us.description: Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how alligators use low pitch rumbles to make the water around them dance; they give a herd of elephants a hearing test. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Science, Animals) - 20140826

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Senses - Scent
bbcearth.us.description: Exploring the world of scent, including animals that have pushed their sense of smell way beyond human abilities; diving into shark-infested waters in the Bahamas. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Science, Animals) - 20140902

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue - Miracles Can Happen
bbcearth.us.description: At a home for rescued baby chimps in Liberia, Jim and Jenny Desmond teach the orphans the skills they would have learned from their mothers in the wild; a new orphan named Miracle is rescued from her life on a chain. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Animals, Nature) - 20200109

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue - Breaking Point
bbcearth.us.description: At Liberia's only home for rescued chimpanzees, there are more new arrivals; Jimmy and Jenny Desmond and their team now have 28 chimps to look after, including an 8-week-old baby called Gaia. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Animals, Nature) - 20200116

bbcearth.us.title: Baby Chimp Rescue - A New Beginning
bbcearth.us.description: Jimmy and Jenny Desmond and their team are at breaking point, with 38 chimps to look after; losing one of them to illness leaves the team more determined than ever to build them all a new sanctuary where they can live like wild chimps. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Animals, Nature) - 20200123

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Stretched to the Limit
bbcearth.us.description: Animals appear to have stretched their natural gifts to the limits, including giraffes and chameleons. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20130129

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - A Curious Hoax?
bbcearth.us.description: Curiosities lead to accusations of forgery. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20130205

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Young Wrinklies
bbcearth.us.description: Sir David Attenborough looks at some amazing quirks of evolution; he encounters two examples where nature has tinkered with the aging process. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20130212

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - A Curious Twist
bbcearth.us.description: David Attenborough looks at the tusk of the narwhal and the spiral shells found on snails and ammonites. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20130219

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Seeing The Pattern
bbcearth.us.description: Beautifully patterned or brightly colored animals attract the attention of collectors. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20130226

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Virgin Births
bbcearth.us.description: Female Komodo dragons can reproduce without contact with a male; female aphids can clone themselves to produce copies. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140218

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Armoured Animals
bbcearth.us.description: Rhinos and hedgehogs protect themselves with body armor in the form of thick skin. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140218

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Life in the Dark
bbcearth.us.description: Animals adapt to life in the dark; owl eyes are too large to move within their sockets; the giant squid has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140225

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Curious Imposters
bbcearth.us.description: Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on amazing animals; he looks at cuckoos and the way the death's-head hawkmoth steals honey. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140225

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Bad Reputations
bbcearth.us.description: Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals; he takes a closer look at the vampire bat. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140304

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Shocking Senses
bbcearth.us.description: How naturalists find out that some eels are electric is revealed. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140304

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Life on Ice
bbcearth.us.description: Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on the wood frog, which freezes solid; he looks at how the emperor penguin breeds. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140311

bbcearth.us.description: Nature produces two unique mechanisms of natural construction; weaving in birds and silk fascinate scientists. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140311

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Strange Parents
bbcearth.us.description: David Attenborough shines the spotlight on female hyenas; he examines why male seahorses give birth. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20140318

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Magical Appearances
bbcearth.us.description: The disappearance of some animals each year puzzled early naturalists; the question arises whether swallows hibernate in mud or underwater and the sudden appearance of butterflies each spring was also a mystery. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20160724

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Impossible Feats
bbcearth.us.description: David Attenborough examines how fleas jump; he tracks the true speed of a cheetah. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20150202

bbcearth.us.description: David Attenborough examines orangutans and crows, two unusual animals that use tools. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20150209

bbcearth.us.description: David Attenborough examines creatures that have fascinated people for centuries; he looks at the expandable bodies of anacondas and camels. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20150216

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities - Curious Feeders
bbcearth.us.description: A look at some species with unusual styles of consuming food, including the gigantic blue whales and the flamboyant flamingos. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20150223

bbcearth.us.description: Humans are not alone in using medicines against injuries and infection and some animals protect themselves with natural remedies in extraordinary ways. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature, Outdoors) - 20160802

bbcearth.us.description: The riches of the Caribbean and the processes that shape them. (Episode, Series, Nature, Environment) - 20070315

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean - Reefs & Wrecks
bbcearth.us.description: An exploration of the stunning underwater treasures of the Caribbean Sea, including the world's second-largest barrier reef and countless shipwrecks. (Episode, Series, Nature, Environment) - 20070507

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean - Hurricane Hell
bbcearth.us.description: The survival stories of the islands' wildlife residents following the Caribbean hurricane season. (Episode, Series, Nature, Environment) - 20070715

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean - Secret Shores
bbcearth.us.description: The wild shore of Central America is the Caribbean's more mysterious side, with beautiful archipelagos of hundreds of islands and wildlife. (Episode, Series, Nature, Environment) - 20070715

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico - Mountain Worlds
bbcearth.us.description: The Serranías del Burro serves as a vital outpost for Mexico's black bears. (Episode, Series, Documentary) - 20171017

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life - Forests of the Maya
bbcearth.us.description: The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds make their home; it is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Travel) - 20170514

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico - Burning North
bbcearth.us.description: A feature on the forces behind Mexico's driest region, and the animals overcoming its conditions. (Episode, Series, Documentary) - 20171031

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam and Thailand Rick Stein travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Thailand and Malaysia Rick travels to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Malaysia and Sri Lanka Rick explores the multi-faceted cuisines of Penang; in Sri Lanka, he continues his passion for seafood by visiting a bustling fishing village.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sri Lanka and Bali Rick visits Sri Lanka and discovers a wealth of hot and spicy vegetable curries.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bangladesh Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul

cinevault.us.title: Conspiracy
cinevault.us.description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-02-15

cinevault.us.title: Straw Dogs
cinevault.us.description: Married couple David (James Marsden) and Amy (Kate Bosworth) move to her hometown of Blackwater, Miss., after her father's death. They have a plan to renovate Amy's old home and prepare it for sale while David works on his latest screenplay. However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

cinevault.us.title: The Stepfather
cinevault.us.description: When Michael Harding (Penn Badgley) returns home from military school, he discovers that his mother (Sela Ward) has a new man, named David (Dylan Walsh), in her life. Though David makes Michael's mother very happy, Michael cannot seem to shake feelings of distrust. He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2009-10-16

cinevault.us.title: Bewitched
cinevault.us.description: Movie star Jack Wyatt (Will Ferrell) has hit a rough patch in his career. Looking to make a comeback, he signs on to play the role of Darrin in a movie version of the popular 1960s sitcom "Bewitched." Jack insists that an unknown is hired to play Darrin's better half, the beguiling witch-housewife Samantha, so the studio finds an up-and-comer named Isabel Bigelow (Nicole Kidman). Once shooting begins, though, Jack learns that Isabel was cast too well -- since she actually is a witch. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2005-06-24

cinevault.us.title: Year One
cinevault.us.description: After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 2009-06-19

cinevault.us.title: Krull
cinevault.us.description: On the planet of Krull, an evil creature called the Beast decimates the world's army and kidnaps the lovely Princess Lyssa, who is destined to become queen. Her brave beau, Prince Colwyn, leads a motley band of warriors, including Ergo and Kegan, to rescue his beloved. However, before he can face the Beast, Colwyn must locate a mystical weapon known as the Glaive, which he can use to slay the hideous villain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1983-07-29

cinevault.us.title: Solo
cinevault.us.description: Android military weapon Solo (Mario Van Peebles) is designed to put down Latin American rebels. But when Solo arrives, the machine feels compassion for the rebels fighting for freedom. Despite Solo's design, he begins fighting for the people he's supposed to kill. When his creators, including Gen. Haynes (Barry Corbin), attempt to bring him back, he flees. But the military doesn't give up. They send an upgraded android into the field to take Solo -- and the villagers -- down. (Action, Movie) - 1996-08-23

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after a successful assassination, a former mercenary finds himself the target of hit squads. (Entertainment) - 2015-07-01

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. (Drama, Crime drama) - 2000

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

(Comedy) - 2008

Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage. paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Paid Off, Styled Up Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Every Woman's Dream Home Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!
