tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Take It To The Ceiling Lisa is a passionate home chef who loves to cook for her family. The last space they have yet to address in their home is the old-school galley kitchen. Ellen will have to get creative to turn this kitchen disaster into the heart of the home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Cluttered Craftsman Clean Up Nominated by their daughter Brittany, Susan and Brad have lived in their craftsman for over 30 years; Susan doesn't think her tiny kitchen needs a glow-up, so Ellen will have to convince her that change is sometimes a good thing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Tiny to Timeless Natalie just bought her own home in LA. It's perfect with just enough space, but she wants to extend the kitchen and improve the functionality and organization! Ellen will have to transform this tiny box of a kitchen into an entirely new space.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Chef in Need Kat is a cool, trendy gal with a passion for cooking that has led her to an incredibly successful career as restaurateur and a chef! The pressure is on Ellen in this episode as Kat is a friend and nothing but the best will do.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Spanish Revival Home Done Right Margaret & Keith are former high school friends who fell for each other later in life and settled into a beautiful old Spanish influenced home. The Hunts have some serious ambition for their dated kitchen, and it may be more than Ellen can handle.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E02 Spies, Lies and Allies: Bertha Agents take to the skies in the "Heli Heist" mission and a "mystery agent" joins the game; Nelly T gets himself into hot water when he starts flirting with two different agents.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E03 Spies, Lies and Allies: Truce or Dare The Challengers must compete in the terrifying "Sea Cave Recon" mission, where one agent pukes out of fear and then kisses his partner on the mouth, and another agent suffers an injury that leaves him naked to his enemies.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E04 Spies, Lies and Allies: Messy A controversial player stirs up some drama, which threatens his alliance; Kyle and Devin's tender bromance is put to the test during the "Undercover Comms" mission; absolute hell breaks loose during the "Down to the Wire" elimination.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E05 Spies, Lies and Allies: Good Vibes and Gladiator The muddy "Mindfield" mission dirties up the game when players must use their brains and brawn in order to succeed; two rookie players debate making a risky move to secure a strong partner.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E06 Spies, Lies and Allies: Alien The slow burning tension between Fessy, Josh, and Amber erupts into chaos; agents are taken for a spin during the dizzying Turning Agents mission; two players have a shocking secret hookup.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E07 Spies, Lies and Allies: Uncle CT Agents are on edge when TJ comes to headquarters with a directive that changes the game; CT comes to a troubling realization about his partner, Berna; players compete in Rage Cage.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E08 Spies, Lies and Allies: The Threat After the Veterans threaten the remaining Rookies, one bold Rookie comes up with a plan to detonate the Veterans' stronghold; Berna calls out all of her rivals in an explosive manner.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E09 Spies, Lies and Allies: The War The Veteran War arrives, testing everyone's loyalty; the muddy Bombshell Battle mission shows who is truly playing dirty; TJ shocks the agents at elimination with a massive twist that will change the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E10 Spies, Lies and Allies: Precious Stones TJ's shocking twist is revealed at the "Diamond Dash" mission and the players struggle to adjust to the new rules.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E11 Spies, Lies and Allies: Mucus Plug One player makes a devastating mistake at the Satellite Sabotage mission that could put his team in jeopardy.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E12 Spies, Lies and Allies: 500 Players commemorate the 500th episode of "The Challenge" with the physically demanding "Brush Contact" mission.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E13 Spies, Lies and Allies: Titanic Cory worries that as the game gets more cutthroat the Vets might turn on him; players compete in the Sunken Intelligence mission, where one player's lack of effort sinks their team's chances of winning.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E13 Spies, Lies and Allies: Titanic Cory worries that as the game gets more cutthroat the Vets might turn on him; players compete in the Sunken Intelligence mission, where one player's lack of effort sinks their team's chances of winning.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E14 Spies, Lies and Allies: Mavericks Agents must turn into mavericks in a "Top Gun" inspired mission; with her back against the wall, Amanda looks to secure her future in the game; when Josh goofs up and says too much, one player holds it against him during a tense nomination.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E15 Spies, Lies and Allies: The Cave of the Wolf After a sneaky plan to sabotage one team is exposed during the brutal "Boom Raiders" mission, massive rifts appear in numerous friendships; the compromised agent makes a bold move at the lair.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E16 Spies, Lies and Allies: Riverdance Agents feel what it's like to get their hands on $1 million; Emy worries the rivalry between her teammates could result in her elimination.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E17 Spies, Lies and Allies: Drop Dead With the finals approaching, players scramble to stay out of elimination; no one can predict who the compromised agent will choose to battle in the lair; just when the players think they are in the clear, TJ drops a bomb.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E18 Spies, Lies and Allies: Night of Mistakes TJ's shocking twist sends the players into a panic as they battle for survival before the final; one player finds themselves on blast for trying to help another player during a tight elimination.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E19 Spies, Lies and Allies: The Decision The remaining challengers fight for their share of the million dollar prize; a close relationship faces a devastating test; agents are crowned winners of "Spies, Lies and Allies" but are then faced with a daunting decision.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S37 E20 Spies, Lies and Allies: Reunion 1 The agents are back to break down their covert moves from Season 37; Maria Menounos gets to the bottom of every conspiracy; discussing if Amber was seeking revenge against Fessy, if Tori and Amanda will ever be friends, and who ate the pizza.

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Prehistoric Archaeology
truehistory.us.description: Prehistoric archeology allows one to glimpse the earliest times in hominid and human history; learning about seminal 20th-century finds of hominids in Africa; discovering the figural cave paintings of Lascaux, Altamira and Chauvet. (World history) - 2016-05-27

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Göbekli Tepe, Çatalhöyük, and Jericho
truehistory.us.description: Significant Neolithic sites; exploring Gobekli Tepe, whose stone rings are the oldest known examples of monumental architecture in the early Near East; the tombs and tower of Jericho; Catalhoyuk is noted for its houses without doors or windows. (World history) - 2016-05-27

truehistory.us.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites - Pyramids, Mummies, and Hieroglyphics
truehistory.us.description: A first look at the wonders of Egyptology; the deciphering of hieroglyphics; the techniques of ancient Egyptian embalming and mummification; the stories behind the building of the Step Pyramid of Zozer, the Pyramids at Giza and the Sphinx. (World history) - 2016-05-27

truehistory.us.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture - Alexander the Great: Greek Culture Spreads
truehistory.us.description: The conquests of Alexander the Great give birth to the Hellenistic world; Alexander's military expansionism brings a vast geographical area under the Greek civilization; Alexander's empire fragments after his death; Alexandria, a center of learning. (World history) - 2020-05-22

truehistory.us.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture - Greece, Rome, Byzantium, and Baghdad
truehistory.us.description: The conflicted relationship between the Greeks and their Roman conquerors; Greek culture's impact on Rome; the founding of the Byzantine Empire, its flourishing of scholarship and theology; the role of Islamic scholars in preserving Greek learning. (World history) - 2020-05-22

truehistory.us.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture - Modern Ideas of Ancient Greece
truehistory.us.description: Constantinople's fall in 1453; the Greeks under the Ottomans; Europe rediscovers classical antiquity; the philosophical spirit of the Renaissance, which brings a sudden interest in the ancient Greeks; the influence of Greek mythology on Western art. (World history) - 2020-05-22

truehistory.us.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture - The Birth of the Greek Nation-State
truehistory.us.description: The struggle of the Greeks under the Ottomans; European intellectuals and Europe's major powers support the movement to free Greece; the nation-state of Greece in 1830; Greece's territorial expansion; its tumultuous modern history up to the present. (World history) - 2020-05-22

truehistory.us.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity - Platonism and Stoicism
truehistory.us.description: The influence of philosophy on the morality and conduct of Rome's ruling classes; an influence rarely matched in the Western tradition; Christian theologians employing the doctrines of these two philosophical schools in defining their own faith. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2011-11-18

truehistory.us.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity - Jews in the Roman Empire
truehistory.us.description: Knowing what role Judaism plays in the Roman Empire; learning how Rome's experience with this stalwart monotheistic faith, the first it has encountered, differs from the challenge of the Christian faith that emerges from it. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2011-11-18

truehistory.us.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity - Christian Challenge - First Conversions
truehistory.us.description: The first years of efforts to convert people to Christianity; the early leadership by James of those who are often called Jewish Christians; the career of Paul, from his own conversion after a vision to his work propagating the message of Jesus. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2011-11-18

truehistory.us.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity - Pagan Response - First Persecutions
truehistory.us.description: Early responses to Christianity; the violent persecutions in Rome under Nero; the legalistic and easily avoided persecutions under later emperors; Roman ignorance of Christianity; the eventual momentum that ignorance gives the new faith. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2011-11-18

truehistory.us.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor - Origins of Greek Civilization
truehistory.us.description: As the Hittites unite Anatolia, early Greeks called Achaeans visit its western reaches; Achaean warlords trade and raid along the shores of Asia Minor; in time, they become the first Greeks to clash with the armies of a great king to the east. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2001-09-25

truehistory.us.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor - The Legend of Troy
truehistory.us.description: The most enduring legacies from early Anatolia are "The Iliad" and "The Odyssey": how the siege of Troy and the exploits of Homer's warrior chieftains fit into the wider tale of imperial struggle and decline during the Greek Dark Age. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2001-09-25

truehistory.us.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor - Iron Age Kingdoms of Asia Minor
truehistory.us.description: From 1200 B.C. to 1000 B.C., migrations reshape Anatolia; Phrygians come from the Balkans, only to be overcome by Cimmerian nomads; in the West, Hittite provincials found trade-rich Lydia, whose last king is Croesus. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2001-09-25

truehistory.us.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor - Emergence of the Polis
truehistory.us.description: From 750 B.C., the Greeks distinguish themselves with the polis, a city-state based on citizen rule; by 500 B.C., Athens devises the first democratic constitution, with all adult male citizens forming the sovereign assembly. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2001-09-25

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - JFK Reconsidered
truehistory.us.description: Discovering how JFK excels at compartmentalizing his life so that few, if anyone, truly knows him. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - 1956: Vice President Kennedy?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the backroom deals of a party that expects the young politician to pay his dues. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - JFK's Pivotal Choices to Win the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Surveying JFK's campaign against the seasoned politician Richard Nixon. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - Unearthing JFK's Public and Private Lives
truehistory.us.description: JFK is a well-known playboy, something of an open secret in Washington during his time in office. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of Anne Hutchinson
truehistory.us.description: There is no toleration of religious dissent in the Massachusetts Bay Colony in the 1600s; Anne Hutchinson shares with others her religious ideas and gathers a following; the governor puts her on trial for heresy; the trials and punishment of Anne. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of John Peter Zenger
truehistory.us.description: Freedom of speech is not recognized liberty; speech critical of the powers can land one in legal trouble; the colonial history of press freedom; attempts to influence juries as they try to affect the libel trial of John Peter Zenger. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - Two Slave Trials
truehistory.us.description: The citizens of the newly formed United States cannot agree on the moral issue of slavery; they are willing to take up its more narrow legal issues; how the legal system supports the institution of slavery; the trials of Anthony Burns and Celia. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of John Brown
truehistory.us.description: John Brown's plan to end slavery comes to a tragic end at Harper's Ferry, Va.; Brown is charged with treason, murder and slave insurrection; John Brown's trial and execution play a significant role in the eventual end of slavery in the US. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1617 The Great Epidemic
truehistory.us.description: The North American continent is never the same after the Great Epidemic of 1617; it wipes out nearly 90 percent of Native Americans and allows British colonization to proceed virtually unchallenged; the defining characteristics of a turning point. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1619 Land of the Free? Slavery Begins
truehistory.us.description: How and why does a democratic America become a slaveholding society; exploring this paradox from its origins in 1619; slaves arrive at Jamestown; the influence of Bacon's Rebellion in 1676; the expansion of slavery throughout the South in the 1800s. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1636 Freedom of Worship - Roger Williams
truehistory.us.description: Roger Williams's efforts to establish freedom of religion, a somewhat forgotten story from early colonial America; religious life in the early Massachusetts settlements; Williams's controversial ideas; his influence on religious freedom in America. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1654 Yearning to Breathe Free - Immigration
truehistory.us.description: A symbolic expression of the idea that all are welcome in America takes place in 1654; the Dutch West India Company allows Jews from Brazil to settle in New Amsterdam; a gateway to understanding immigration as a central theme in American history. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - Young Man Lincoln
truehistory.us.description: Abraham Lincoln is born with little more than his natural talents; his father is more than contented with the life of a classic Jeffersonian farmer; the Lincolns move from Indiana to Illinois; Abraham strikes out on his own and never looks back. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - Whig Meteor
truehistory.us.description: Lincoln's entry into politics coincides with the emergence of a new national political party, the Whigs; Lincoln at the forefront of Whig agitation to improve business; his own business ventures flop; he takes up law in Springfield, Illinois. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - Lincoln, Law, and Politics
truehistory.us.description: Through his law partner, John Todd Stuart, Lincoln meets and marries Mary Todd in 1842; he wins the election to Congress in 1846, but his term is undistinguished; Lincoln returns to a life of domestic unhappiness; substantial success as an attorney. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - The Mind of Abraham Lincoln
truehistory.us.description: Lincoln's folksiness is a shield he rarely lets down; many see him as an introverted, slightly aloof lawyer; he dislikes wanna-be aristocrats and is a tremendous reader; he believes in God, but not the God of any formal religion. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

classica.us.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

classica.us.title: Gara Garayev: Herbstsonaten
classica.us.description: Pianist Vadim Repin und Bratschist Murad Hüseynov interpretieren Gara Garayevs Bratschensonate und 24 Präludien für Klavier. Aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Geschrieben und inszeniert von Juliette Swierczewski und aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Obwohl Garayev ein Komponist des 20. Jahrhunderts ist, trägt seine Musik Anklänge an die romantische Musik. 10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E14 Rocket Ski Rescue Crusher cheats with a pair of rocket skis to impress his Grammy. But when the skis malfunction and carry him all over town, Blaze, AJ and Grammy work together so they can save her runaway grandson.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Dinosaur Parade Herds of dinosaurs are marching through Axle City! But when Crusher pushes his way into the parade, he scatters dinos everywhere, and it's up to Blaze, AJ and Zeg to find and rescue them.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E7 Pups Save The Butterflies / Pups Save An Underground Chicken Skye uses her super-sonic wings to find out where a group of butterflies is coming from. The PAW Patrol investigates the disappearance of Adventure Bay's Chickaletta statue.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E8 Pups Save The Bookmobile / Pups Save Heady Humdinger Everest calls Ryder to alert him of an out-of-control book truck. Rubble builds a ramp out of rocks to get the Kitten Catastrophe Crew's bulldozer down from a cliff.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E25 Crabby Boots / Papi's Picnic Party Dora & Boots meet Shelly, a hermit crab missing her shell. Dora travels across the beach in search of her old shell. // Papi is having a quesadilla picnic, but he forgot the ingredients!

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E5 Goldie's Understudies / ONE Little Peek When Goldie overbooks herself, she trains her friends to be her understudies for the day. / It's Baby Shark's birthday and it'll take all the patience he can muster to not peek at his gift.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E20 Pickle Power Crusher builds a vacuum to clean up his big mess, but the machine goes haywire, sucking up Crusher & everything in its path! Now Pickle must team up with Blaze & AJ to stop the vacuum & save Crusher.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E16 Race Car Superstar Blaze & AJ visit VelocityVille, a town full of race cars where everybody loves to go fast! When a snooty car named Speedrick traps all the other racers, Blaze must transform free his new friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E10 Pups And Katie Stop The Barking Kitty Crew!/pups Save The Glasses Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties, Katie & the pups rescue the town// Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses, creates chaos in his path. The Paw Patrol save him & his specs!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E11 Pups Vs. A Neon Humdinger/Pups Save A Royal Painting Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the Paw Patrol must stop it from rolling through town // Sweetie steals a painting of the Princess & attempts to replace it with one of herself.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tim Rex in Space
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E8 Double Booked / Bogweed / Prizes Tim tries to be at two parties at once. / Tim tries to find a bogweed free snack for Kai. / After losing again and again, Tia tries to win every party game.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E7 The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Center / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Space Show When Motor needs help at the fire station, a new Fire Captain comes to town to help train all the pups as new firefighter recruits. Charger can't wait to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show!

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E1 X Marks The Spot Ahoy, mateys! Set sail on a pirate adventure with Gil, Molly and their Guppy friends as they help a friendly pirate use a treasure map to find where X marks the spot!

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E2 Happy Holidays, Mr Grumpfish! The Bubble Guppies are giving gifts, lighting lights, & baking cookies! And when the clock strikes eight everyone in town will gather for the holiday party, except Mr. Grumpfish.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E4 Cupcake Tree When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert, Cakey, to work together to save CatRat.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Tiny Chef Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 Chips & Dip / Bee's Knees Tea Chef and Olly make French onion dip, but the onions make Chef cry! / Chef goes all out for a royal tea party when the Queen Bee visits.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E5 Stand Up And Sit Down! Gardner Tim wants to teach his students, Margarita and Rose, how to stand up and how to sit down. For this, he begins a fun game to make them practice it in a very entertained way.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E16 Ninja Soup Blackbelt isn't the only Ninja Master in his family- his Grandma Ninja has awesome moves too! But when she gets a nasty cold, Blaze, AJ & Blackbelt set out to make the most powerful medicine there is.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E17 Royal Rescue A visit to the King's castle goes awry when the King accidentally catapults himself far, far away! To bring him home, Blaze, AJ & the King's pet dragon must transform into knights in shining armor!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E9 Sea Patrol: Pups Save The Pirated Sea Patroller After Sid Swashbuckle the pirate and Arrby the pirate pup steal the Sea Patroller, Ryder uses the lighthouse to project a fake ship out at sea and trick Sid and Arrby into returning their boat.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E10 Pups Save The Pawpaws / Pups Save A Popped Top Tracker and the PAW Patrol make juice from mountain papayas, also called pawpaws. Rocky builds a scarecrow to stop a flock of hungry crows from eating a crop of corn.

10shakeperth.au.title: Super Duper Bunny League
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 The Bunnies Save Christmas! When a group of greedy aliens scheme to steal Christmas, it's up to Stumpy to remind everyone what the holiday is all about.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E11 A Finful Of Sand Dollars / Cretins Of The Night Sheriff Sandy keeps the peace at Kamp Koral, but Narlene the Bandit Queen threatens it all. / Kidferatu trains SpongeBob and Patrick in vampirism, but a vampire hunter is on the loose.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E5 Movie Stars / Dr. Smart Science Patrick and SpongeBob work at the movie theatre to watch a new premiere. // With Sandy's guidance, Patrick hosts a science show.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Smurfs
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E19 Smurf To The Future! Handy invents a time machine for Blossom, the duo accidentally go back to prehistoric times.They are taken prisoner by Prehistoric Smurfs who plan on sacrificing Handy to a ferocious beast.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E4 A Bug's Strife/all The Rage Dad tears the house apart trying to find the cricket ruining his peaceful day. // Tired of getting pummelled during dodgeball, Lincoln, and the gang use Clyde's untapped rage without him knowing.

10shakeperth.au.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E20 The Siege Of The North Part 2 Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defences, and he reveals a sinister plan.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E9 Don't Look Now / Seance Schmeance SpongeBob and Patrick go to see the latest horror film, only to be seemingly stalked by the villain./ SpongeBob holds a seance at the Krusty Krab to learn the recipe for a long-lost sandwich.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E10 Kenny the Cat / Yeti Krabs SpongeBob will do anything to get to meet his newest hero, Kenny The Cat. Attempting to get more work out of Squidward, Mr. Krabs spins the story of the monstrous Yeti Crab, which eats lazy workers.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 Pre-Hibernation Week/life Of Crime Sandy is going into hibernation in a week, and she wants to pack in a million activities. // SpongeBob and Patrick end up popping Mr. Krabs balloon and fear the consequences.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 Patchy The Pirate Presents The Spongebob Squarepants Christmas Special Nobody in Bikini Bottom has heard of Christmas or Santa Claus. SpongeBob wants to bring Christmas to Bikini Bottom this year and his enthusiasm is infectious.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S13 E18 Delivery To Monster Island / Ride Patrick Ride SpongeBob and Plankton must work together to survive an island of deadly monsters. // SpongeBob teaches Patrick how to ride a bike.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S13 E286 Hot Crossed Nuts / Sir Urchin And Snail Fail Sandy's homemade snack becomes a big hit at the Krusty Krab. // SpongeBob and Patrick's favourite comedy duo has a falling out on live television.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E32 Sterling And Karrueche Tran Lxiv On Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Karrueche Tran watch some bros get diagnosed with DUDE DOCTORS, get caught off guard by some UNEXPECTED INTERRUPTIONS, and check out people who are POOL PARTIED OUT.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E33 Sterling And Rocsi Diaz Xix On this episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo and Rocsi Diaz roll strikes in PEOPLE BOWLING, fire off BOARD BULLETS and work up their appetite for LIVING SNACKS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E35 Sterling And Rocsi Diaz Xxi On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Rocsi Diaz leave no glass unbroken in COMPLETE SHATTERS, have a bad day golfing in SAND TRAP SADNESS, and get rocked by some boats in BOAT BATTERED.

10shakeperth.au.title: Taskmaster Australia
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E6 There's budget art, coffee challenges, taxi cowboy ballads, unwelcome mats and alien debates.

10shakeperth.au.title: Taskmaster Australia
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E7 There's dashboard distractions, sticky situations, sabotaged sculptures, and meet cute memories.

10shakeperth.au.title: Catfish
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E16 Mike & Caroline Mike met Caroline online. He grew suspicious when she continually avoided to meet him. Mike then learns that she is diagnosed with cancer. Is Caroline an imposter or is she just afraid?

abcmelbourne.au.title: News Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E209 Tuesday 20 October 2026 News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport with Catherine Murphy and weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News Mornings ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E209 Tuesday 20 October 2026 Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Australian Story
abcmelbourne.au.description: E34 The Road Back It was one of Australia's deadliest bus crashes, killing 10 and injuring 25. Three years on, survivors speak for the first time about the horror, their recovery and the need for systemic change.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Planet America
abcmelbourne.au.description: E32 Red states at risk: can Trump maintain a Republican majority or will a blue wave see Democrats expand the map? With 2 weeks till Midterms Chas and John look at the latest polls and issues that'll decide who controls Congress.

abcmelbourne.au.title: The State Of Man
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Marc Fennell investigates what it means to be a man today, where the manosphere is reshaping views on masculinity.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News At Noon ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E209 Tuesday 20 October 2026 The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Beyond Paradise
abcmelbourne.au.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 A local chocolatier falls under suspicion when three customers are poisoned after sampling her confections. Humphrey must explore every avenue to determine whether she orchestrated the attack or was framed.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Back Roads
abcmelbourne.au.description: S5 E3 Woolgoolga, NSW Heather Ewart explores a vibrant coastal community in northern New South Wales, where East meets West and which the locals affectionately call Woopi.

abcmelbourne.au.title: You Can't Ask That
abcmelbourne.au.description: S6 E3 Obsessive Compulsive Disorder According to SANE Australia, roughly 1 in 50 Australians have Obsessive Compulsive Disorder. People with OCD want others to know it's so much more than washing hands or keeping a clean desk.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Murdoch Mysteries ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: S9 E17 From Buffalo with Love The shooting of a man in a burlesque club sends Murdoch and Brackenreid to Buffalo, New York to investigate, while Crabtree becomes close to one of the dancers.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs Australia
abcmelbourne.au.description: S11 E8 Strath Creek A former Olympic snowboarder and her builder husband take on a mountainous challenge when they decide to build a unique shed-like home on a remote ridge in Victoria's Strath Creek.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Long Lost Family
abcmelbourne.au.description: S5 E4 Episode 4 We meet one woman searching for her sister, hoping to discover the truth behind a family tragedy and another woman desperate to find the only person in the world that she knows she is related to, her mother.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Antiques Roadshow
